The stated reason for the entire redesign — that the oracle-derived knowledge model is unrealistically small and cascading — is withdrawn in writing, and the incumbent's numbers stand. (3) THE RADIUS DOES NOT TRANSFER, IN THE DANGEROUS DIRECTION. A6-2 shows the surrogate's r=1 share significantly HIGHER than the referent's on 595 paired instances, where the detectable shift is 4.2 to 5.5 points: the deployment knowledge source is systematically optimistic about robustness, and no sentence about practice may be written from it. (4) THE SUBSTRATE ARGUMENT DIES. The matched control is indistinguishable from the real corpus on the separation distribution. 'Real structure is not exchangeable with Erdős-Rényi' becomes a density-tuning defect, Decision 2 reopens, and A6-3 loses its positive control, so every A6-1 non-rejection becomes uninterpretable at the same moment. (5) THE CERTIFICATE IS VACUOUS. phi(r+1) lands below 0.5 AND the H4 baseline — count your own claims — predicts r as well as the search does. The radius is then an expensive re-derivation of |K| and the contribution is the geometry, not the measurement. (6) THE APPLIED TIER CANNOT CARRY A REFERENT. Fewer than 4 of 12 documented pairs survive the observables-only filters, and the eight papers turn out to assert almost nothing codable in prose (inter-coder kappa below 0.61). Knowledge source number two of Zé's two fixed decisions then has no data behind it, and the referent collapses to the analyst round, whose pooled ±0.044 interval is stated in advance so the shrunken claim is already written. (7) NEW, AND THE CHEAPEST TO REACH. The dependency-closed differential disagrees even once, so the claimed theorem is false and the enumeration stays global; tractable coverage stays at 44.8% of the candidate population, more than half the corpus becomes a censoring record rather than a measurement, and the 1,839.78-second wall is reported as a scope limit on a framework whose own literature now expects an amortised sensitivity bound in orders of magnitude less compute. In that case the protocol has bought an expensive referent measured on a corpus that grew only from the frame change, and the honest paper says the exact combinatorial certificate does not scale past the networks where it already ran.

name: The Sachs Twin
one_sentence: It fixes ONE fully worked deployed analysis (Sachs: real data, author-named pairs, author-asserted knowledge, approximate interventions) as the anchor, builds a simulable twin so the audit has a truth the real side cannot have, admits an instance only if it carries the anchor's four properties plus a twin — and, unlike the draft, it stamps every emitted number with the content hash of the graph its C-hat came from, so an oracle CPDAG cannot pass as an analyst's graph by labelling; the hardening pass then found that the current pipeline admits ZERO partially-oriented analyst graphs (g0_undirected_edges = 0 in all 831 admissible instances, with all 518 o_g0_not_identified rejections falling at coverage 0.5 and 0.25 and none at 1.0), which means a realistic sparse K yields an empty population until the extension-enumerating O* is replaced by the closed-form MPDAG functional.

axes.decision: The population is DEPLOYABLE INSTANCES: quintuples (network, data-or-twin, X, Y, K) where the graph is domain-accepted or author-published, the query is one a human named, and K is one a human asserted. Strata, never pooled in a headline. T1 ANCHOR = Sachs alone: sachs.bif.gz (sha256 ed1830fb...), 11 nodes, 17 edges, CPDAG FULLY UNDIRECTED (undirected_fraction 1.0 against a corpus median of 0.107), chain components of sizes 8 and 3 (verified in descriptive_structure.json), plus the 853-observation general condition as real data, plus a TWIN: a linear-Gaussian SEM fitted to the consensus DAG on those rows, simulated at n in {853, 8530, 85300}. T2a APPLIED = the 8 dagitty files named for a source publication (Acid_1996, Didelez_2010, Kampen_2014, Polzer_2012, Schipf_2010, Sebastiani_2005, Shrier_2008, Thoemmes_2013). T2b TEXTBOOK = the 4 dagitty canonical examples (confounding, mediator, paths, M-bias). The draft pooled these as one 'applied' tier and that is a substrate confound: 'paths' contributes 20 admissible instances and 13 of the 126 law exceptions while having no author, no domain and no publication to harvest, and all 12 files carry exposure/outcome so the annotation cannot distinguish them. T3 BENCH = 24 BIF + 4 bnjson, per network, never as a corpus fraction. T0 CONTROL = a 1:1 MATCHED synthetic arm: for each T1/T2a network, generate at the SAME n and SAME expected degree as that network, not into a band (the draft matched to the real corpus's mean-degree RANGE 1.60-9.86, which is the whole range and therefore not a match at all), same K construction, same gate, same pipeline, B=20 seeds, behind a committed generator script. THE PROVENANCE STAMP, which is the hardening the draft's own weakness list asked for and did not implement: every record carries chat_source_sha256 and generating_dag_sha256. When they are equal the record is in the AUDIT arm by construction, whatever it is labelled. On T1-real generating_dag_sha256 is null and Panel O is a genuine deployment number, because the published consensus graph is a document an analyst can read. On any twin and on all of T3 the two hashes are equal, so Panel O there is audit-only and the deployment number is Panel E. This retires the draft's 'Panel O licensing is a judgement call' by making it a byte comparison. PREREQUISITES, blocking: (i) dagitty.py:44 captures an attrs group (exposure/outcome/latent/adjusted/selected) that ParsedNetwork has no field for; retain it. Counted across the 12 files: 12 exposure, 12 outcome, 3 adjusted, 4 latent, and 1 SELECTED, which the draft did not notice and which asserts selection into the sample, breaking causal sufficiency exactly as M-bias breaks it; both need a written scope decision, not a parse flag. (ii) The anchor's structure and its data come from different sources: sachs.bif.gz is a DISCRETE pgmpy network and the 853 rows are continuous, so the BIF DAG must be checked edge-for-edge against the Sachs et al. consensus network before the twin is fitted; a mismatch means the corpus structure and the real data describe different graphs. (iii) PER-NETWORK CAP of 40 admissible instances, derived as a 1,000-instance target over the 25 networks that yield anything; today barley (189) and insurance (160) supply 42.0% of all 831 instances from 2 of 25 networks, so every pair-weighted headline in circulation is a statement about two networks. THE TRANSFER STATISTIC, declared before any radius, and it is the SAME list as the matching list for T0: (i) CPDAG undirected fraction, (ii) chain-component size distribution, (iii) treatment-to-nearest-O*-member separation inside the chain component REPORTED JOINTLY WITH ITS UNDEFINED RATE, (iv) mean degree, (v) var- and R^2-sortability.
axes.justification: Ledger A1 destroys the founding substrate argument: the 52.9% infinite-ER-radii figure is refuted by the repo's own 'UNREACHED (excluded above): 0' over 2,334 draws, 14.2% is a five-generator pooled figure against Erdos-Renyi's own 12.5%, max finite radius is 5 for random generators and 13 once the designed backdoor family is pooled, and the arms are unmatched on five parameters with no committed generator script. So the substrate is argued by DEPLOYMENT membership, not by contrast. The T2a/T2b split follows from the ledger's own no-pooling rule applied to a distinction it did not draw. The hash stamp implements ledger A6's requirement that the manifest record per quantity whether the true DAG was on its computation path, and turns the invariant from a paragraph into something a harness enforces. The separation-with-undefined-rate rule is forced by the recorded 2.6-fold gap (44.3% of real admissible instances undefined against 17.1% of random-generator instances): a separation comparison across strata conditions on a differently selected measurable subset in each. The per-network cap is forced by the ledger's dual-weighting rule, which reports the disagreement (45.4% pair-weighted against 35.6% network-weighted) but does not remove its cause. The transfer statistic is licensed by Henckel/Perkovic/Maathuis (arXiv:1907.02435): O* = pa(cn)\forb is LOCAL, which is why the radius equalled the separation in 792 of 792 designed instances. Sortability is mandatory per Reisach 2021 (arXiv:2102.13647) and 2023 (arXiv:2303.18211), with iSCM's reversed R^2-sortability on denser graphs (Ormaniec arXiv:2406.11601, Herman arXiv:2503.17037). Chen ICLR 2022 (arXiv:2110.03239) gives the tiering rule: transfer works iff the target lies in the SUPPORT of the randomisation, so tiers must COVER the deployed target rather than be broad. Sachs is used as accepted and not true, per the vault's own CSCD precedent.
axes.falsifiable_check: TWIN-FIDELITY CHECK, pre-registered before the twin is fitted, WITH ITS POWER STATED because the draft's version cannot support its own decision rule. Hold the instance set fixed across Sachs-real and Sachs-twin at the same n, K and estimator, with C-hat ESTIMATED from data on both sides (with C-hat taken as the accepted graph's CPDAG the two are identical by construction and the check is vacuous). Compare on the pre-declared summary: share at r=1, median r, max r, and the IDENTITY of the first-failing retraction set per instance. DECISION RULE: more than 1 mismatch on the 13 admissible Sachs instances, or an r=1 share differing by more than the tolerance fixed from 20-seed dispersion measured before either side is looked at, and simulation does not stand in for deployment on this framework's own quantity; every T3 number is demoted to a labelled control in the running text, and the claim reduces to T1 union T2a. POWER, which the draft omitted: at n = 13 the rule of 'more than 1' has 77% power against a true mismatch rate of 20% and only 38% against 10% (exact binomial). The anchor therefore cannot carry this check alone, and the identical rule runs on the T3 twins where n is large enough. SECOND CHECK, self-directed: T1's five transfer coordinates must lie inside T3's per-network range on at least 4 of 5. The undirected-fraction coordinate is already known to fail (1.0 against median 0.107), so the check is designed to bite; failure on 2 or more coordinates means T3 may not be cited in support of any T1 claim and the anchor's unrepresentativeness is printed as a finding. THIRD CHECK, new: the anchor has ZERO separation variance. All 13 admissible Sachs instances carry separation = 1 with status 'measured' (verified in instances.jsonl). No claim relating r to separation may be stated on T1, and if the observables-only frame does not introduce separation variation on the anchor, that limitation goes in the abstract rather than in a limitations paragraph.
axes.cost: Compute: negligible; describe.py already ran the corpus at seconds_to_cpdag <= 0.152 s (arth150 worst). Sortability profiles: one pass per continuous network, minutes. Agent-hours ~20: dagitty attrs retention plus the M-bias and selected-node scope decisions 5; twin fitting and simulation harness 6; the 1:1 matched control generator with a committed script 6; the chat_source_sha256 / generating_dag_sha256 plumbing and its harness guard 3. Human-hours ~6: acquire the Sachs observational and perturbation tables, run the edge-for-edge check of sachs.bif.gz against the consensus network, review the M-bias and selection-node scope arguments.

axes.decision: Replace 'screen all n(n-1) ordered pairs' with a declared non-adaptive frame in three ranks. RANK A (T1/T2): THE QUERY IS GIVEN, NOT SAMPLED. Each network contributes the (X,Y) its own authors declared, recovered from the attrs group (12 of 12 files carry exactly one exposure and one outcome); for Sachs, the pairs the paper singles out, principally Erk->Akt, validated by siRNA knockdown of Erk, plus Mek->Erk and Mek->Akt, which the U0126 condition perturbs. RANK B: all ordered pairs inside the same chain component as the declared X; for Sachs at most 8*7 + 3*2 = 62. RANK C (T3 only): a seeded deterministic stride, never a function of any computed radius, capped at 40 admissible instances per network, with sampled_pairs reported as the realised integer count and sampling_rate retired as a headline (hailfinder records rate 0.812 with stride 1 realising 3,080 of 3,080). ADMISSIBILITY IS REBUILT ON OBSERVABLES ONLY. Of the current filters, five read the true DAG. no_causal_path (42,618, tested on dag.descendants) becomes Y in possible_descendants(X, G0), which already exists in mpdag_criterion/paths.py and is polynomial. no_valid_adjustment_set becomes is_amenable(G0,X,Y) plus GAC-validity of the closed-form O* at G0, both observable and both already implemented. empty_set_trivially_valid (3,738) is recomputed as is_gac_valid_mpdag(G0,X,Y,emptyset) and becomes a REPORTED STRATUM rather than a rejection, with its count re-derived rather than inherited, because the observable predicate is not the true-DAG one. select_knowledge is handled in A3. no_atomic_perturbation_changes_validity (1,659) is ABOLISHED as a rejection because it reads the true DAG in three ways (dag.descendants, optimal_adjustment_set_dag for its target o, and knowledge_to_recover for its perturbation set). CORRECTION TO THE DRAFT, which justified the same abolition wrongly: it is NOT true that this filter 'rejects precisely when r >= 2'. It tests single-element retractions of the FULL k_true against O(true DAG) in the SUBSET geometry, not retractions of the instance's own K in the covering geometry. If the two agreed, every coverage-1.0 instance would have r = 1; the measured r1 share at coverage 1.0 is 69.8%, so 30% of gate-passing instances have covering-radius at least 2. The filter goes because it reads the truth, not because its semantics were the answer. KEPT as observable: treatment_not_in_or_adjacent_to_component (66,330). o_g0_extensions_intractable (280) survives only as a MEASUREMENT LIMIT until A5's lever 0 lands, after which it should vanish. RECORD PER (X,Y): a cheap LOWER BOUND on the number of valid adjustment sets rather than an enumeration, obtained by testing O* union {v} for each v outside forb(X,Y) with the polynomial GAC predicate, which is what decides whether the incumbent RoCA test has power on the instance and is unrecorded today; separation with an explicit status string; a pre-filter and post-filter population table with rejected pairs kept as CENSORED rows; both pair-weighted and network-weighted aggregates with zero-yield networks in the denominator.
axes.justification: The brief's invariant forbids true-DAG quantities on the deployment path and ledger A2 names the five violating filters with their counts from analysis_summary.json. Ledger A2 also records that the budget sits on the wrong side of the filter (115,974 pairs screened for 831 admissible on 25 of 39 networks, pathfinder burning its entire 1,200 s cap on three runs and producing no radius). Rank A is licensed by Schubert, Claassen and Magliacane (LOAD, arXiv:2510.14582): a strictly local query policy is legitimate because O* can be recovered around a target pair without learning the global graph, which is the deployment arm's information set. Su and Henckel (arXiv:2206.07533, CONFIRMED) require at least two valid adjustment sets for the over-identification test to have power, so the count decides scoreability; the lower-bound probe is preferred over enumeration because enumeration is precisely the cost A5 removes, and a lower bound of 2 is all the comparison needs. Dual weighting is mandatory because the weights differ materially (separation >= 2 at 45.4% pair-weighted against 35.6% network-weighted; r=1 at 61.1% against 71.3%) and the per-network cap removes the cause of that gap rather than only reporting it. Non-adaptivity is the repo's own pre-registration commitment, kept deliberately.
axes.falsifiable_check: FRAME-SELECTION CHECK, now with its sample size derived. On T3, where both sides are cheap, compute the separation distribution and the r=1 share separately on pairs the frame ADMITS and on pairs it rejects for observables-only reasons, carrying the rejected ones as censored records. DECISION RULE: fix the tolerance first from the seed dispersion of the r=1 share over 20 seeds, measured before either population is inspected; a difference in the r=1 share beyond that tolerance means the frame is confounded with the answer, Rank C reverts to a full stride, and the population-shaping table is published as the finding. SAMPLE SIZE, which the draft did not state: to detect a 10-point difference in a share near 0.6 at 80% power and alpha 0.05 requires about 16*p(1-p)/delta^2 = 384 instances per group; the current corpus supplies 831 admitted, so the admitted side is adequately powered and the censored side must be sampled to at least 384. Below that the check is reported as underpowered rather than as passing. SECOND RULE, aimed at Rank A: if fewer than half the Rank A queries survive observables-only admissibility, the deployment population the framework claims to serve is mostly outside its own scope, and that scope goes in the abstract. THIRD RULE, new and cheap: separation must be compared as a JOINT distribution over {undefined, 1, 2, ...}, never as a conditional statistic over the defined subset, and both undefined rates must be printed whenever two strata are compared. The recorded 44.3%-against-17.1% gap is exactly the confound that makes a conditional comparison uninterpretable, and no version of the comparison has ever reported it.
axes.cost: Compute: Rank A is about 40 queries; Rank B on Sachs is at most 62 ordered pairs; both finish in seconds. Rank C reuses the existing 115,974-pair screen, which now terminates rather than burning a wall cap because the expensive true-DAG filters are gone. Agent-hours ~12: rewrite fast_gate into an observables-only frame with the pre/post-filter population table 8; per-network cap and realised-count reporting 2; the polynomial lower-bound probe for the number of valid adjustment sets 2. Human-hours ~1 to confirm the recovered exposure/outcome pairs against the eight source papers. Wall-clock for the T3 re-run is dominated by A5, order 2 to 4 h.

axes.decision: DELETE select_knowledge FROM THE DEPLOYMENT PATH. It calls knowledge_to_recover(dag, cpdag), reads the ground-truth DAG, and at coverage 1.0 returns the full recovering set so G0 IS the true DAG, verified: g0_undirected_edges = 0 in 543 of 543 coverage-1.0 instances. Replace it with three sources and two controls. SOURCE 1, PUBLICATION HARVEST (K_pub), primary, and now STAGED with a derived stopping rule instead of the draft's flat nine papers. The discriminator is a PAIRED per-network comparison (same network, K built twice), so its permutation is a sign-flip over networks and its minimum attainable two-sided p is 2/2^k: k = 5 gives 0.0625 and cannot reach significance at all, k = 6 gives 0.031. STAGE 1 is therefore exactly 6 networks, ordered by admissible yield so the hours buy instances: Polzer_2012 (66), Kampen_2014 (42), sachs (13), Schipf_2010 (13), Sebastiani_2005 (11), Acid_1996 (10) — 155 instances. STAGE 2 adds Shrier_2008 (10) and Didelez_2010 (8), taking the floor to 2/256 = 0.0078; Thoemmes_2013 is last because it yields zero admissible instances today. SCOPE CUT INSIDE THE HARVEST: transcribe first only claims within graph distance 2 of {X} union O*(G0), because the project's own 2026-07-17 pilot measured silent bias exactly 0 at graph distance at least 1 from the query (0 of 791 statements) and O* is a local functional. This is pre-registered as a PREDICTION, not assumed, precisely because it was measured on the synthetic substrate this redesign says does not transfer; the harvest widens to the whole paper the first time any first-failing retraction set contains a claim beyond distance 2. Two independent transcription passes with disagreements adjudicated by quoting the sentence, every constraint carrying {doi, page, verbatim_sentence} and the authors' own hedge as source-reported confidence. Free alongside it: the authors' own declared adjustment sets from attrs (Didelez_2010 adjusted = {Age, Smo}; Thoemmes_2013 adjusted = {s2}), used as a comparison target, never as an input. SOURCE 2, LLM SURROGATE (K_llm), temperature 0, mandatory response cache, prompt hash and model id in the manifest, K frozen before r is computed, query form TRIPLET or CAUSAL-ORDER and never pairwise, elicited at all four granularities, refinement budget declared and reported as ZERO. Amendment to the draft: FIVE pre-registered paraphrase prompts with permuted mention order, each frozen and each its own K. That is the only dispersion a temperature-0 surrogate can have, and it operationalises checkable #11's requirement that the prompt be part of the error model rather than a footnote. SOURCE 3, CORRELATED-ERROR GENERATOR (K_tier), the object under test: synth/knowledge.py's tiered operator misfiles a node into a wrong temporal tier before reading off assertions, is deterministic, is already written, its docstring calls it the realistic case, and it has never been run on real graphs. CONTROL A, THE NULL, REDEFINED — the draft's K = emptyset is DEGENERATE, not null: with no claims there is nothing to retract, G0 = C-hat, and the radius is not large, it is undefined. The null must be a SIZE- AND SHAPE-MATCHED RANDOM CONSISTENT arm K_rand: same |K|, same granularity mix and same distance-from-X profile as the source under test, claims drawn uniformly among Meek-consistent orientations with no domain content. K = emptyset is kept as a DEGENERATE REFERENCE reported as a status, never as a radius. CONTROL B, MISSING: consistent AND TRUE but incomplete, taxonomy.py's unimplemented arm, the only place knowledge_to_recover may appear and only inside the post-hoc audit. |K| MATCHING IS MANDATORY on every cross-source comparison: sources differ in size, and an unmatched comparison reproduces the coverage-stratum confound in new clothes (543/182/106 instances with r=1 at 69.8/51.1/34.0% is a composition effect, and median |K_G0| moves 12/6/4 across the same strata). Compare at matched |K_G0| by a declared subsampling rule and report matched and unmatched side by side. THE ERROR PROCESS IS MEASURED, NOT STIPULATED. Per source per network the audit emits on one common scale: fraction reversed, omitted, invented, each split by granularity, by graph distance from X, AND BY EDGE TYPE (data-compelled against orientable), which is the half of checkable #7 the draft dropped; the Meek Algorithm-1 rejection rate with its pre-filter and post-filter distributions; cascade size; cycles emitted before repair; and a permutation test on whether wrong assertions cluster in graph space against a same-count uniform null. Every rate is also restated on the b-LOAD rho/mu scale and the CSCD 0.3-reversal scale so the three arms are quantitatively comparable rather than adjacent. CONFIDENCE IS RETAINED BUT SEALED: the deployment arm may not read source-reported confidence until the audit arm publishes a calibration curve of stated confidence against measured correctness; until then it is a recorded column. SEVERITY IS A DEPLOYMENT-ARM OUTPUT: taxonomy.py's BENIGN / EFFICIENCY / VALIDITY / UNIDENTIFIABLE classify what a retraction costs by comparing Z and O* at G0 and at the perturbed graph, which needs no truth, so each first-failing retraction is reported with its severity class. THE ANCHOR SUPPLIES ITS OWN CONSISTENT-BUT-FALSE ASSERTION, pre-registered before the harvest: the consensus Sachs graph carries PIP3 -> PIP2, while a biologist reading the PI3K reaction (PI3K phosphorylates PIP2 to PIP3) asserts PIP2 -> PIP3. It is a real domain assertion contradicting the accepted graph on an admissible pair — PIP3 -> PIP2 is verified admissible at r = 1, |Z| = 1, inside the 3-node {Plcg, PIP2, PIP3} chain component — and it is not injected by us.
axes.justification: Ledger A3 calls select_knowledge the single largest defect against the invariant and adds that knowledge_to_recover is greedy and gain-maximising, so the K it returns is smaller and more cascading than a real analyst's, biasing the other binding term of r_val <= min(s, |K_G0|) downward. Perkovic, Kalisch and Maathuis (UAI 2017, arXiv:1707.02171) supply the reason a knowledge model must emit consistent-but-false K: consistency is a purely graphical predicate that says nothing about truth, and Thm 4.4's soundness is conditional on G being the TRUE MPDAG, so a merely-consistent-but-false G silently returns a provably wrong set. Triplet over pairwise follows Vashishtha et al. (arXiv:2310.15117, CONFIRMED): pairwise produced over 3k cycles on Child and over 5k on Neuropathic against 0 under triplet, with SHD falling 177 to 28, and Child, Asia, Alarm, Insurance and Sachs are all inside our own BIF corpus, so pairwise elicitation would manufacture part of the error process we then measure. All four granularities follow from the ledger's record that b-LOAD's noise study is confined to required edges and that this is the weakness all four reviewers and the metareview named. Provenance discipline follows AutoElicit (arXiv:2411.17284), which fixes the reporting format and nothing about accuracy. Confidence retention follows the CSCD measurement that soft beats hard under noisy knowledge (PC recall 0.577 -> 0.526 under noisy hard constraints, restored by a soft penalty); sealing it until calibration exists follows the ledger's own note that stated confidence is data about the expert, not evidence about the edge. The redefined null follows Gervet et al. (JEDM 2020) in purpose but fixes the instrument: an expert-designed structure adding at most +0.01 AUC on seven of nine datasets is a comparison against a NON-VACUOUS alternative, which K = emptyset is not. The paired-permutation floor of 2/2^k is arithmetic, and it is why 6 rather than 9 is the pre-registered stage-1 harvest. The harvest is not optional: the ledger's hardest fact is that no published study measures per-edge expert error separating omission from commission against a known-true DAG, surviving a 1,100-note corpus grep, a seven-dimension web sweep and a gap-fill that exhausted its budget and hit HTTP 403 at all four journals where the measurement would live. The referent must be built.
axes.falsifiable_check: THE GENERATOR DISCRIMINATOR, with a decision rule that can retire our own generator. Per network build K from K_tier and from K_pub, compute the pre-registered feature vector (coverage per granularity; distance-from-X distribution; reversed/omitted/invented separately; edge-type split; pairwise graph distance among the wrong assertions; Meek rejection rate; cascade size; cycles before repair) and run a PAIRED sign-flip permutation test at |K|-matched sizes. DECISION RULE, with the tolerance fixed before the referent is looked at because a permutation test on enough instances always rejects: rejection on the CASCADE-SIZE or the DISTANCE-FROM-X coordinate, the two the radius is provably most sensitive to because O* is local, and K_tier may not license any sentence about real knowledge; every synthetic-K number moves to a labelled control stratum. POWER, stated: with k = 6 networks the floor is p = 0.031 and with all 8 harvestable networks it is 0.0078, so this test can never be strong evidence of similarity, only of difference — a non-rejection is reported as underpowered, never as agreement. A cheaper and sharper companion on a statistic never computed on any of the three candidate generators: pre-register that K_pub's median edges-compelled-per-assertion must lie within a factor of 2 of K_tier's; outside that factor the synthetic generator is mis-specified in exactly the direction the radius reads. THIRD RULE, on our own harvest: if K_pub's realised wrongness against the twin's truth is zero on every network, the framework has no object to price on this substrate and the anchor must move to a domain where experts are measurably wrong. FOURTH RULE, on the locality scope cut: if any first-failing retraction set contains a claim at graph distance greater than 2 from {X} union O*, the distance-2 harvest was wrong, the cut is withdrawn in writing, and the harvest widens to the full paper for every network already transcribed.
axes.cost: Human-hours ~16, down from the draft's 30 and still the binding constraint. Six papers, two typed transcription passes each, restricted to the distance-2 neighbourhood of the declared query: about 2 h per paper plus 4 h adjudication. Non-parallelisable across a single reader; the second pass is the one to hand to the co-author, which converts a self-initiated task into one with a counterparty. Agent compute: the surrogate is about 40 networks x 4 granularities x 5 paraphrase prompts, order 800 cached calls, a few dollars and about 3 agent-hours including cache and manifest wiring; K_tier is written and runs in minutes. Agent-hours ~22: the three-source loader with provenance and the ElicitedConstraint path (every body in knowledge/elicit.py currently raises NotImplementedError) 10; K_rand and MISSING arms in taxonomy.py 4; the error-decomposition emitter including edge-type and severity 6; the |K|-matching harness 2. Discriminator: seconds once the features exist.

axes.decision: CENTRE at G0 = Meek(C-hat, K), never at the truth. Already correct in code (hybrid.breakdown_radius takes no true DAG; search/exact.local_up_covers takes (cpdag, g)) and now machine-checkable: every record carries true_dag_on_path, chat_source_sha256 and generating_dag_sha256, and the harness refuses to write a deployment-arm record where the first two hashes are equal or a true-DAG argument was on the call stack. UNIT: BFS hop count on the covering relation restricted to the FIXED-SKELETON sub-poset G_C-hat, named in the manifest as 'd_L on G_Chat'. Never SHD, never rank arithmetic. OPERATOR: retraction, derived rather than assumed (failure is upward-closed because refinement shrinks the represented DAG set, so a flip costs exactly two atomic moves and the first failure is always reached by LOSING an assertion). Extended to the granularities K now carries: a TIER retraction un-orients everything the tier compelled under Meek R1; FORBIDDEN-EDGE and ANCESTRAL-CONSTRAINT retractions each get a defined move; each ships with a differential against the required-edge move, because nothing in this lineage has measured whether a forbidden-edge retraction perturbs like a required-edge one and the current operator has no forbidden-edge move at all. THE SHELL MEASURE, specified rather than gestured at. The draft said 'estimated by uniform sampling within the shell' while also declaring the covering-graph distance the definition and subset enumeration an approximation; those two statements are incompatible, because there is no procedure that samples uniformly from a covering-graph shell whose relation has no known graphical characterisation. So: phi_j^sub is defined explicitly on the RETRACTION-SUBSET geometry — draw j-subsets of K_G0 uniformly, re-close under Meek, test GAC validity — declared an estimate on the approximating geometry, and differenced against covering-graph shells on every instance where |K_G0| is small enough to enumerate both. REPORT TWO REFERENCE MEASURES, not one: uniform phi_j^sub, and an O*-RELEVANCE-WEIGHTED phi_j^sub obtained by reweighting the same draws. The draft deferred the weighted version; it is promoted because it costs one reweighting of an already-drawn sample, it is the project's own ranked next step, it is the slot Taeb et al. section 7 declares empty, and it is the only lever against the degeneracy that the deployment-realistic regime creates: the 2026-07-17 pilot found rho* four-valued and top-censored at |K| <= 4, and a real applied paper asserts few things, so the honest deployment regime is exactly the small-|K| regime where the uniform radius has almost no dynamic range. SENTINELS extended before anything new is measured: UNREACHED = -1 stays a status, never averaged, plotted numerically or compared with '<'; DEGENERATE = 0 stays a status; r_0's three distinct infinite cases (no zero in the hull, hull undefined, extension cap hit) get three statuses instead of one Python None. And a reporting rule the draft missed: r >= 1 by construction because Z is read off G0, so r = 1 is the FLOOR and means ZERO safe moves; 61.1% of the corpus sits there, so the headline is SAFE-MOVES = r - 1, not r. SCHEMA HARMONISATION, with a correction: the ledger's claim that real admissible records carry no method field is REFUTED by the file — all 831 carry method (local_up_fast 811, e1_ladder 20), oracle (mpdag_criterion 831), exact (True 831) and stats. The real asymmetry is r_0, whose records carry none of these, so harmonisation goes upward to the instances.jsonl schema. GEOMETRY UNIFICATION: breakdown_radius walks the covering graph while the r_0 probe enumerates raw retraction subsets, and its j is not the same metric as d. Declare the covering-graph distance the definition and the subset enumeration the approximation, and run a differential on every instance where both are affordable. PRIOR ART, RESCOPED: the draft treated four readings as equally open. The Taeb section 6 conflict is now three independent full-text reads (both ledgers plus the vault's own 2026-09-06 read, which records one paragraph, one figure, ADMGs not MPDAGs, upward-only, no background knowledge, no Meek, no guarantee) against one gap-fill reading, so it is settled by weight of independent reads with the dissent recorded, not reopened. What remains genuinely blocking is narrower and cheaper: Appendix F.3, the full text of arXiv:2010.08611 whose very identity is disputed, and a scoped first sweep of the never-queried stability-radius family (Sotskov/Emelichev, Goberna et al., Renegar) and the AGM contraction / minimal-correction-set families.
axes.justification: Ledger A4 throughout. SHD is refused because SHD_1 <= SHD_2 <= d_L,pseudo with an explicit example at d_L,pseudo = 1 while SHD = n-1 (Taeb et al. Prop 12, Example 2, Fig 5): an SHD-denominated radius OVER-certifies. Rank arithmetic is refused because for |V| >= 4 the MPDAG poset is not graded, so no rank function exists, and it is neither a semi-lattice nor semimodular (Prop 9, Table 3, Thm 1). The fixed-skeleton restriction is forced by the fact, stated three times in that source, that the MPDAG covering relation has no known graphical characterisation, which is also why the shell measure cannot be defined on that relation and must be defined on subsets; whether gradedness returns on G_C-hat is recorded as a CONJECTURE. Retraction is derived from THEOREMS.md Theorem 1. The shell measure exists because the ledger records there is none: BFS returns the nearest failure and nothing about how much of shell j fails, and measured conservativeness is 0.43 to 0.47, so roughly 44% of graphs outside the certified radius still admit Z. A guarantee that is right 100% of the time and tight 56% of the time is two numbers. The weighted measure is licensed as unoccupied by Taeb et al. section 7 naming it future work, and is motivated by the measured top-censoring at small |K|. The prior-art rescoping follows the evidence: three independent full reads against one, with Appendix F.3 unretrieved in all three passes and the stability-radius and AGM families never queried at all, which is where the residual risk actually lives.
axes.falsifiable_check: THE ONE-SIDED EXACTNESS AUDIT, made to bite, with its sample size derived. Every exact radius inherits Anti-Exchange Case B => Lemma R => Property S => Lemma L => Conjecture 2, verified at 0 violations in 36,094 applicable triples but unproved, and its failure direction is FAVOURABLE to the hypothesis under test (radii too large, optimistic about robustness), while the counter-directed caveat, the MPDAG-level GAC forbidden set verified on about 2.5M cases and not proved, could deflate. Three rules. (1) Extend the violation search to every T1/T2 instance; any violation is published with its instance id and every affected radius is restated as an upper bound. (2) POST-HOC REALISED-FAILURE AUDIT on the twins: reveal the DAG, find the true minimal retraction set that invalidates Z, classify each certificate as equal / SAFE (r smaller than truth) / DANGEROUS (r larger than truth), never as an agreement rate, because agreement hides the sign and the sign is the guarantee. DECISION RULE: the ceiling is pre-registered at 1.7%, from the existing measurement where the 95% band errs DANGEROUS at most 1.7% at every n while the point hull errs 24.7% at n = 200 and still 18.1% at n = 20,000. SAMPLE SIZE, which the draft left unstated and which changes where the claim can live: a one-sided 95% upper bound of 1.7% needs 3/0.017 = 177 twin instances with zero DANGEROUS events, or 4.74/0.017 = 279 if one event is to be tolerated. Pre-register 300 twin instances. The anchor's 13 cannot carry this headline; it rides on the T3 twins and the anchor supplies the worked example. (3) Operator check: if the forbidden-edge and tier differentials show that a block move and an edge move give the same radius distribution on a fixed instance set, the granularity taxonomy buys nothing and the operator collapses back to required edges, which must be written rather than quietly kept. (4) Reference-measure check: if the uniform and O*-weighted phi_r agree within their sampling error on every instance, the weighting adds nothing and is dropped in writing; if they disagree, the certificate must say which measure it is stated under.
axes.cost: Compute for the shell-fraction estimator: at the measured 1.07 ms per GAC call at n = 20, a 400-draw shell gives a binomial standard error of at most 2.5% at 0.43 s per shell per instance, so 1,000 instances at 3 shells is about 21 minutes, and the O*-weighted measure reuses the same draws at zero extra cost. T1/T2 is seconds. Agent-hours ~18: tier, forbidden and ancestral operators plus their differentials 10; phi_j^sub estimator and the weighted reweighting 5; sentinel and schema harmonisation raising r_0 to the instances.jsonl schema 3. Human-hours ~6, blocking but rescoped: Appendix F.3 and the full text of arXiv:2010.08611 4 h; a first scoped sweep of the stability-radius and AGM/MCS families 2 h. The draft budgeted 12 h here on the strength of treating the Taeb section 6 conflict as open; three independent full-text reads against one settle it, so those hours are cut and the dissent is recorded rather than re-litigated.

axes.decision: THE GATE IS NOT PAID, AND THE PROTOCOL DOES NOT RUN AT ALL WITHOUT THE FIRST LEVER. LEVER 0, THE ONE THE DRAFT MISSED AND THE ONE THAT DECIDES WHETHER THIS PROTOCOL HAS A POPULATION: replace optimal_adjustment_set_mpdag, which computes O* by enumerating EVERY DAG extension of G0 and returning None unless all of them agree, with the closed-form MPDAG functional O*(G) = pa_G(cn(X,Y)) \ forb(X,Y), assembled from causal_nodes, forbidden_set, possible_descendants and is_amenable, all already implemented and polynomial in src/bkrobust/mpdag_criterion/. This is not a speedup, it is the admission criterion. Verified: g0_undirected_edges = 0 in ALL 831 admissible instances, and all 518 o_g0_not_identified rejections fall at coverage 0.5 (232) and 0.25 (286) with ZERO at coverage 1.0. The mechanism is mechanical — incomplete knowledge leaves undirected edges in G0, extensions then disagree about O*, and the instance is rejected — so the pipeline systematically deletes exactly the instances where the analyst's knowledge is incomplete, which is every real deployment. There is not one partially-oriented analyst graph anywhere in the measured corpus. A realistic sparse K_pub therefore yields an EMPTY admissible population on the current code, and A3 cannot be executed until lever 0 lands. It ships with a differential against the enumeration on every instance where both are affordable, and with an honest caveat: if the closed form proves merely VALID rather than OPTIMAL on MPDAGs, the target is restated as the closed-form back-door set and every r_opt claim drops. LEVER 1, PREDICATE SUBSTITUTION for validity: route the ball path through is_gac_valid_mpdag rather than is_valid_adjustment_set_mpdag. Measured in results/axisa3/gate_predicate_swap.json: 2,240 ordered pairs across child, insurance, asia, sachs and water, 2,240 identical verdicts, 0 disagreements, 20.22 s -> 2.47 s, worst case 1.07 ms per call at n = 20; Theorem 14 says the two coincide exactly on Z = O(...). Note the scope the draft blurred: lever 1 fixes VALIDITY and cannot compute O*, which is why lever 0 is separate and prior. LEVER 2, COMPONENT RESTRICTION wherever an enumeration genuinely remains. The 1,839.78 s call was a GLOBAL 2^k enumeration over ecoli70's 25 undirected edges while pa_D(X) depends only on X's chain component. Derived from the corpus component-size vectors, and stated as bounds because only sizes are recorded: diabetes has components [3, 2x24] holding exactly 26 undirected edges, which is precisely the connectivity minimum, so the largest per-component enumeration is 2^2 against a global 2^26 — a factor of 16.8 million, exactly determined — and diabetes alone supplies 178 of the 280 intractable rejections. ecoli70 has [10,8,5,2] with 25 edges against a minimum of 21, so its largest component holds 9 to 13 and 2^25 falls to at most 2^13. arth150 has [19,14,5,4,3,2,2,2] with 45 against a minimum of 43, so 2^45 falls to at most 2^20. It does NOTHING on insurance (one 11-node component holding all 18) or child (one 12-node component holding all 12), which is why lever 1 is not optional and lever 0 is prior to both. LEVER 3, BUDGET GEOMETRY: BFS returns the nearest failure and stops; phi is sampled; a per-instance wall cap writes wall_until_timeout_s on a _meta row and is never a measurement; o_g0_extensions_intractable stays a distinct status until lever 0 makes it vacant. TWO PANELS, SEPARATED BY HASH RATHER THAN BY LABEL. Panel O uses C-hat = the CPDAG of the accepted or published graph. Where generating_dag_sha256 is null (T1-real) that is a document the analyst reads and Panel O is a deployment number. Where the two hashes are EQUAL — every twin, all of T3 — Panel O is an audit-arm number by construction and may not carry a deployment headline. This is stricter than the draft, which kept an 'oracle idealisation' label on T3 Panel O and listed the tension as an unresolved weakness. Panel E uses C-hat from a CPDAG-EMITTING algorithm at finite n; a front-end emitting a fully oriented DAG is inadmissible because skeleton-times-order factorisation commits to one topological order and destroys the undirected chain component the radius is defined on. Grid n in {853, 8530, 85300} on the Sachs twin, plotted on Pi = n / (|V| * d_exp/2). ESTIMATOR HELD FIXED: Frisch-Waugh-Lovell from Sigma-hat alone, se = sqrt(sigma^2_{y|x,z} / (n sigma^2_{x|z})), the same formula for population and sample, so the true DAG enters only to generate the sample. THE 95% BAND IS THE PROTOCOL OBJECT, not the point hull, on a measurement: the hull errs DANGEROUS 24.7% at n = 200 and 18.1% at n = 20,000 while the band errs at most 1.7% at every n, even though the band's raw agreement looks worse (7.8% against 57.0% on magic-irri at n = 200). TWO QUANTITIES, NEVER ONE INTERVAL: the perturbation layer prices structural error and any conformal layer prices sampling error; if the graph knowledge is wrong the ESTIMAND moves, which is outside any covariate-shift correction. The certificate is declared once and early as a DETERMINISTIC COMBINATORIAL certificate. Coverage is reported CONDITIONAL ON r. Any Panel E interval carries a resampling or test-inversion correction or is labelled uncorrected in writing.
axes.justification: Ledger A5 states that the tractability bottleneck is the gate, not the radius search: 1,839.78 s for one is_valid_adjustment_set_mpdag call on a 46-node network against 0.02 to 0.04 s for an entire r_0, and that the earlier '>120 s' was a waiting limit rather than a measurement. It states the cost is an IMPLEMENTATION CHOICE because the enumeration is global 2^k while pa_D(X) depends only on X's chain component, and names component-restriction the highest-leverage change in the repo. The per-component figures above turn that into numbers and, more usefully, expose where it is a null fix. Lever 0 goes further than anything in the ledger: reading measure.py against instances.jsonl shows that the extension-agreement definition of O* is not merely slow but population-shaping, and the coverage-conditional pattern of the 518 rejections (286 at 0.25, 232 at 0.5, 0 at 1.0) is the fingerprint. The CPDAG-emitting requirement follows Thompson et al. Arrow (arXiv:2605.07204). Two-panel reporting is obligatory because the direct parent paper (LOAD, arXiv:2510.14582) reports both regimes side by side; separating them by hash rather than by label is what makes the brief's invariant enforceable rather than declarative. The band-over-hull decision is the repo's own three-bucket measurement over 226 instances. The two-quantity rule follows Lei and Candes (JRSS-B 83(5)). The post-selection caveat follows Gradu/Zrnic/Wang/Jordan (arXiv:2208.05949), Chang/Guo/Malinsky (arXiv:2405.06763) and Strieder et al. (arXiv:2106.05694). Coverage conditional on r follows Smucler/Robins/Rotnitzky (arXiv:2502.16673). The compute bar is external: amortised causal sensitivity (Javurek et al. arXiv:2605.10590) means 1,839.78 s is not merely slow relative to our own search, so either the gate is made cheap or the protocol must argue why an exact combinatorial certificate is worth orders of magnitude more compute than an amortised bound. Making it cheap is the cheaper argument.
axes.falsifiable_check: LEVER-0 ADMISSION CHECK, run first and blocking, because it decides whether anything else can run. Rebuild the population with the closed-form O* and report the number of admissible instances whose G0 retains at least one undirected edge. DECISION RULE: that number is 0 today across all 831 instances; if after lever 0 it is still under 384 — the sample the A2 frame-selection check needs per group — then the framework as implemented applies only to analysts whose knowledge orients the entire relevant chain component, and that scope sentence goes in the abstract instead of a radius headline. SKELETON-FRAGILITY CHECK, which decides which panel is honest. On the Sachs twin and on T3, as n falls, does the ESTIMATED CPDAG's chain-component structure, the object the radius is defined on, survive? Compare the estimated CPDAG's undirected fraction, component-size distribution and separation distribution against the descriptive table committed before any radius. DECISION RULE: if at the deployment n (853 for Sachs) the estimated CPDAG's largest chain component containing X differs from the published-graph one on more than a pre-registered fraction of its nodes, Panel E is the honest panel and every Panel O number is labelled an idealisation in the abstract, not an appendix. If the radius distribution is stable across panels the idealisation is licensed WITH A NUMBER rather than by silence. LEVER DIFFERENTIALS: run levers 0, 1 and 2 against the enumeration on every instance small enough to run both, following the template of the existing 46,800-case fast_gate differential; state the PREDICTED direction of each substitution before running it and publish the disagreement rate WITH ITS SIGN. A single disagreement in the lever-1 or lever-2 differential blocks that substitution; a lever-0 disagreement means the closed form is not the optimal set on MPDAGs and the target Z is renamed. The fast_gate precedent is why: the author predicted 'strictly weaker' and the measurement said 'strictly stricter', 16 disagreements in 46,800 cases. THIRD RULE: if the finite-n danger rate fails to improve with sample size, as it already does not (24.7% to 18.1% across a hundredfold increase), the problem is a coverage problem and not a sample-size problem, and the protocol says so instead of adding samples.
axes.cost: Agent-hours ~26: closed-form O* plus its differential and the amenability path 10, and it is now the single highest-leverage change in the repo, ahead of component restriction; component-restriction theorem, implementation and differential 8; predicate routing across the ball path 3; Panel E discovery harness 5. Wall-clock: with all three levers the T3 sweep runs 2 to 4 h (the existing run's slowest instance was 0.16 s with inexact_instances = 0, so the radius side was never the cost), the Panel E discovery grid 4 to 8 h, shell fractions about 21 min, the 300-instance twin sweep at B = 20 seeds about 20 min. Roughly one overnight run, about 12 h wall. Without lever 0 the sweep does not produce a population at all rather than producing one slowly; without levers 1 and 2 arth150 needs 2^45 extensions and pathfinder already censors on three runs at a 1,200 s cap. Human-hours ~2 to review the three differential reports and their signs.

axes.decision: The referent is BUILT in three layers and the headline is always a GAP WITH A SIGN. LAYER 1, THE INTERVENTIONAL LEG (T1 only). Sachs's inhibitor and activator conditions supply approximate interventions, including U0126 on Mek and the siRNA knockdown of Erk that validated Erk -> Akt. For each admissible T1 instance with a corresponding condition, compare the adjustment-based estimate against the perturbation contrast, PRE-REGISTERED AS A ONE-SIDED SIGN-AND-ORDERING CHECK, never a point-estimate agreement test, with the caveat printed in full: these are pharmacological inhibitors and knockdowns that change mechanisms rather than implementing clean do(), so a disagreement is evidence about the analysis OR about the intervention and cannot separate the two. LAYER 2, THE TWO-SAMPLE KNOWLEDGE AUDIT between K_pub and each generator on the A3 feature vector, per stratum, |K|-matched, never pooled. LAYER 3, THE RADIUS-TRANSFER TEST, the one with teeth because the reported quantity is r: instance set held FIXED, the same (network, X, Y) triples under every knowledge source, comparing full radius distributions on the pre-declared summary with the SIGN reported, because a source producing systematically LARGER radii than the referent is optimistic about robustness. POWER AND DISPERSION, stated per headline rather than as a blanket instruction, because the draft's 'seed dispersion on every headline fraction' is not implementable: a Panel O radius on a fixed C-hat and a fixed K is DETERMINISTIC and has no seed, so a plus-or-minus there would be fabricated. Dispersion attaches to exactly five places and is reported over B = 20 replicate seeds, which estimates the between-seed SD to a relative precision of 1/sqrt(2(B-1)) = 16%: (a) Panel E rates over SEM and sample seeds; (b) the twin DANGEROUS rate over sample seeds; (c) K_llm rates over the five pre-registered paraphrase prompts, which is the only dispersion a temperature-0 surrogate can have; (d) Control C over generator seeds; (e) K_rand over draw seeds. Instance counts, each derived: 300 twin instances for the 1.7% DANGEROUS ceiling (177 for a zero-event bound, 279 to tolerate one); 6 harvested networks for the paired discriminator to reach p < 0.05 at all, 8 for its floor of 0.0078; 384 per group for the frame-selection check; 96 instances carrying at least 2 valid adjustment sets for a RoCA discordance RATE at plus-or-minus 10 points, below which only the EXISTENCE claim is made; 13 anchor instances giving 77% power against a 20% twin mismatch and 38% against 10%. POSITIVE CONTROL, rebuilt: the same two-sample machinery on 1:1-matched synthetic K against T1/T2a K, which MUST reject or the test has no power. CONTAMINATION SCREEN: per network elicit with real names, elicit with scrambled names, and run a cold-recall probe with no data; pre-register a threshold, and if the named-minus-anonymised gap exceeds it AND cold recall reproduces the published adjacency above chance, that network's surrogate error moves to a separate stratum. State plainly that this gap BOUNDS memorisation from above and domain knowledge from below without separating them. The four T2b textbook graphs (confounding, mediator, paths, M-bias) are canonical and maximally memorisable, so they bound the recitation ceiling from above and are reported as that bound rather than as instances. The only clean control remains a post-cutoff or newly drawn DAG. THE REFUSALS ARE PRINTED: precision and recall against the Sachs reference network are REFUSED in writing, because that network is inferred from observational plus interventional single-cell data and validated post hoc, so domain-accepted means accepted and not true; and the benchmark-consistency rates (Sachs 26.70%, Insurance 31.6%, Ecoli70 32.9%, Child 54.0%, Asia 54.0%, Diabetes 57.9%) are LLM-judged agreement with 38,081 papers, never an error rate and never a pre-deployment gate. THE DECISION-RELEVANT QUANTITY, RESEQUENCED. The draft put EVPPI first among decision-relevant outputs and then named it the likely casualty; it is demoted to a triggered stage. Stage 1 is the FIRST-FAILING RETRACTION SET, named in domain terms, with its SEVERITY class (BENIGN / EFFICIENCY / VALIDITY / UNIDENTIFIABLE from taxonomy.py, all computable at G0 and the perturbed graph without truth) and the RoCA verdict beside it. That is decision-relevant, needs no loss function, and is precisely what the naive count-your-claims baseline cannot produce: H4 can return a number and can never return WHICH claim. Stage 2, EVPPI against the twin's true effect with the prior taken from the harvest, runs only if the harvest completes and the certificate survives the DANGEROUS gate. REPORTING DISCIPLINE, kept verbatim from the repo's own apparatus: three-way separation of censored runs from measurement limits from structural rejections; statuses as strings, never numbers; assumption_status naming per claim which unproved thing it depends on and which direction its failure moves the answer; the descriptive table committed before the first radius; the rejected optimisation recorded next to the accepted one; a committed generator script for EVERY arm, since the missing script for random_control.jsonl is this axis's own counter-example to the third-party-rerun standard it imposes on others; and analysis_summary.json declared canonical, since four committed files carry different headline figures for the same quantity (report_real_graphs.md and analysis_summary.json at 45.4%, LOG.md:788 at 46.4%).
axes.justification: Ledger A6's founding constraint is that no published study measures a domain expert's per-edge error rate on causal-graph orientations against a known-true DAG, and that this survived a 1,100-note corpus grep, a web sweep, and a gap-fill that exhausted a 200-call budget while blocked by HTTP 403 at Reliability Engineering & System Safety, Risk Analysis, IJAR and Knowledge-Based Systems. So the referent is built and the harvest is the build. The audit FORM is licensed by Herman et al. (CLeaR 2025, arXiv:2503.17037): state the statistic, measure it on both sides, report the gap and its sign. The deployment/post-hoc split is externally justified: counterfactual metrics do not recover the estimators preferred by observable metrics on the same semi-simulated data, and rankings do not transfer from semi-simulated benchmarks to real data even when only the evaluation regime changes (Panagopoulos arXiv:2605.10430). The refusal of precision and recall on Sachs is the vault's own CSCD precedent, and the correction record states Sachs supplies no oracle DAG. The contamination screen is required because ASIA, ALARM, CHILD, INSURANCE and SACHS all sit in our BIF corpus and in the published evaluation sets of LLM-plus-SCM work (CausalSynth arXiv:2605.17528; contamination survey arXiv:2502.14425; per-item flagging arXiv:2605.21543). No second LLM validates K, because judges and domain experts reach opposite conclusions on the same pairs and the bias is worse in the comparative setting that is the standard remedy (arXiv:2606.12071). The RoCA leg fixes the scope limit: Su and Henckel's over-identification test fires on graph errors that change the set of valid adjustment sets and has NO POWER exactly when every compared set is biased by the same amount, so the licensed narrow claim is that the class of orientation errors keeping all valid adjustment sets valid is untestable by consistency checks, and THAT is the class the radius prices. The decision-relevance requirement comes from the CSCD rejection, where both reviewers read 'stability not correctness' as the ceiling rather than the strength; the resequencing follows from that same evidence, since a named first-failing claim set delivers the decision relevance immediately while EVPPI (Sadatsafavi et al., Value in Health 2013) needs a loss function the project has not written and sits behind the harvest. The dispersion rules follow Sadeghi and AbdAlmageed (arXiv:2603.17405), whose reported 95.1 +/- 2.4 reproduced at 69.1 +/- 21.7; the derived instance counts are the arithmetic that makes that requirement executable rather than aspirational. The outsider-audit standard comes from Mourao et al. (arXiv:2603.15928).
axes.falsifiable_check: THE DEPLOYMENT/TWIN DISAGREEMENT IS THE AUDIT'S OWN FALSIFIER, pre-registered with a ceiling and now with a sample size. Hold the instance set fixed across Sachs-real and Sachs-twin at the same n, K and estimator, C-hat estimated on both sides. DECISION RULE: a DANGEROUS rate above 1.7% on 300 twin instances, or a first-failing retraction set differing between real and twin on more than 1 of the 13 admissible Sachs instances, and the audit reports in the running text that the simulated referent does not stand in for the deployed one; every T3 number is demoted to a labelled control. SECOND RULE, positive control: if the two-sample machinery FAILS to reject 1:1-matched synthetic K against T1/T2a K, the discriminator has no power and no negative result from it may be reported as evidence of realism. THIRD RULE, decision relevance, now stated so it can fire on the anchor: the certificate must change at least one decision, operationalised as an instance where the radius fires and RoCA does not, or where the first-failing retraction set names a claim the analyst had no other reason to doubt. If on all 13 Sachs instances RoCA fires exactly when the radius does, pricing adds nothing over testing on the deployed case and the framework's motivating argument fails on its own anchor. FOURTH RULE, contamination: if the cold-recall probe reproduces the published adjacency above chance on a majority of networks, the surrogate is not measuring expertise on this corpus and its arm is reported only on the post-cutoff or newly drawn graph. FIFTH RULE, the naive baseline, which has been pre-registered and unrun for six consecutive sessions and is the most likely way this framework loses: H4 predicts r as min(separation, |K_G0|) and already agrees on 337 of 463 real instances (72.8%). Pre-register that the radius earns its place only through the column H4 cannot produce — the IDENTITY of the first-failing retraction set and its severity class. If the number alone is the deliverable, H4 wins and the radius is dropped; that outcome is reported, not buried.
axes.cost: Human-hours ~14: 4 to align the Sachs perturbation conditions to graph nodes and write the imperfect-intervention caveat; 8 to adjudicate the discriminator, radius-transfer and audit outputs; 2 folded into the pre-registration hours booked below. Agent-hours ~22: audit arm with equal/SAFE/DANGEROUS classification, the per-source error decomposition, the RoCA leg and the fixed-instance radius-transfer test 14; contamination screen 3; the power and dispersion reporting layer, which is new work rather than a convention 5. EVPPI's 10 hours are cut from the baseline budget and re-enter only on its trigger. Compute: two-sample and permutation tests are seconds once features exist; the contamination screen is about 40 networks x 3 probes x 2 models, roughly 240 cached calls, about an hour; the interventional leg is minutes. The real cost of this axis is sequencing: every quantity here is defined against K_pub, so nothing in A6 runs before A3's stage-1 harvest, and A3 in turn cannot run before A5's lever 0 gives it a non-empty population.

arms: ARM 1 — DEPLOYMENT. Computes r from analyst-observable quantities only: r(C-hat, K, X, Y, Sigma-hat, n). HELD FIXED across every cell: the centre G0 = Meek(C-hat, K); the operator (retraction); the unit (d_L on the fixed-skeleton sub-poset G_C-hat); the estimator (Frisch-Waugh-Lovell from Sigma-hat, the same formula for population and sample); the sentinel conventions; the 95% band rather than the point hull; and, enforced by a harness guard rather than a paragraph, true_dag_on_path = false together with chat_source_sha256 != generating_dag_sha256. VARIES: substrate stratum (T1 anchor / T2a applied / T2b textbook / T3 bench / T0 matched control); knowledge source (K_pub harvest / K_llm surrogate x 5 paraphrase prompts / K_tier correlated generator / K_rand matched null / MISSING); C-hat panel (published-graph CPDAG where it is a document, vs estimated at finite n by a CPDAG-emitting algorithm); constraint granularity (required / forbidden / tier / ancestral). Nothing here ever calls select_knowledge, knowledge_to_recover, optimal_adjustment_set_dag, dag.descendants, or any filter reading the true DAG.

ARM 2 — POST-HOC AUDIT. Runs only after every deployment record is frozen and content-hashed, and reveals the truth purely to check the certificate. HELD FIXED: the frozen deployment records, which may not be recomputed. VARIES: which truth-revealed quantity is computed — the realised minimal retraction set and the equal / SAFE / DANGEROUS classification; the per-source error decomposition (reversed, omitted, invented, each split by granularity, by graph distance from X and by edge type, plus pre-filter and post-filter Meek rejection distributions, cascade size, cycles before repair, and the clustering permutation test); the stated-confidence calibration curve, which must be published before the deployment arm is permitted to read confidence at all; and, on its trigger, EVPPI against the twin's true effect. This is the ONLY place knowledge_to_recover runs, as the yardstick for scoring an elicited K. It is ALSO where every Panel O number on a twin or on T3 lands, because there the two hashes are equal by construction. On T1-real no truth exists, so the audit runs the interventional leg and prints the refusal of precision and recall against the Sachs reference network.

CONTROL A (deployment arm) — K_rand, the MATCHED NULL. Same |K|, same granularity mix and same distance-from-X profile as the source under test, claims drawn uniformly among Meek-consistent orientations with no domain content. Distinguishes 'the radius is large' from 'the knowledge carried no domain information'. HELD FIXED: instance set, estimator, C-hat panel, |K|. VARIES: the draw seed, over B = 20 seeds. NOTE: K = emptyset, which the draft used as its null, is NOT this arm. With no claims there is nothing to retract, G0 = C-hat, and the radius is undefined rather than large; it is retained only as a DEGENERATE REFERENCE reported as a status.

CONTROL B (deployment arm) — MISSING knowledge: consistent AND TRUE but incomplete, taxonomy.py's unimplemented arm. It costs efficiency but never validity, so it is the arm against which every false-knowledge arm is read; without it a large radius is confounded with weak knowledge from the other direction. HELD FIXED: instance set, |K| matched to the source under test. VARIES: which true subset is withheld.

CONTROL C (outside both arms) — 1:1 MATCHED SYNTHETIC negative control, labelled and never a comparator in a headline. For each T1/T2a network, generated at the SAME n and SAME expected degree as that network — not into the corpus-wide mean-degree band, which spans 1.60 to 9.86 and is therefore not a match — run through the identical pipeline with the same K-construction, gate and coverage setting, reported per network and per seed over B = 20 seeds, behind a committed generator script. Its only job is the positive-control power check: the two-sample machinery must reject here or it has no power anywhere. Every one of the five transfer statistics is reported for each matched pair, including the undefined-separation rate, whose 2.6-fold gap between the existing arms is why an unmatched rejection would be uninterpretable.

ARM 0 — PREREQUISITE, blocking and not optional. Lands lever 0 (closed-form MPDAG O*) and re-derives the admissible population. Its output is a single number reported before any radius: how many admissible instances have a G0 that still carries an undirected edge. That number is 0 across all 831 instances today. If it stays below 384 after lever 0, the framework applies only to analysts whose knowledge orients the entire relevant chain component, and that is the paper's scope sentence rather than its headline.
primary_table: One row per DEPLOYABLE INSTANCE, keyed by (stratum, network, X, Y, knowledge source, C-hat panel, n, seed). Columns: stratum | network | X | Y | K source | C-hat panel | chat_source_sha256 == generating_dag_sha256? (the dual-role flag that decides which ARM the row belongs to) | n | |K| | |K_G0| | undirected edges remaining in G0 | |Z| | Z, NAMED (e.g. {PKA}) | separation, or its status string, with the stratum's undefined RATE printed in the same block | r_val | SAFE-MOVES = r_val - 1, which is the headline number because r >= 1 by construction | FIRST-FAILING RETRACTION SET, by named claim (e.g. 'withdraw PKC->PKA and PKA->Mek') | SEVERITY of that failure (BENIGN / EFFICIENCY / VALIDITY / UNIDENTIFIABLE) | phi_r uniform +/- se | phi_r O*-weighted +/- se | r_0 with its three-way status | RoCA fired? | lower bound on the number of valid adjustment sets | H4 prediction min(s, |K_G0|) and its residual | audit verdict: equal / SAFE / DANGEROUS | assumes. A ROW MEANS: for this analyst, on this query, with these asserted claims, adjusting for this named set — how many of your own claims you could withdraw before the set stops being valid, WHICH claims kill it first and what that failure costs, how much of the breaking shell actually breaks under two reference measures, whether the incumbent test would have caught it, what the naive count-your-claims baseline would have said, and whether the certificate held when the truth was revealed. The table opens with the thirteen verified Sachs rows in protein names: PIP3->PIP2 at r = 1 (safe-moves 0, |Z| = 1, inside the 3-node {Plcg, PIP2, PIP3} component, and the claim that kills it is the PIP2/PIP3 orientation a biologist reading the PI3K reaction states the other way round), Mek->Akt and Mek->Erk at r = 2 with |Z| = 1, the six PKA->{Akt, Erk, Jnk, Mek, P38, Raf} rows at r = 1, the three Raf->{Akt, Erk, Mek} rows at r = 1 with |Z| = 2, and Erk->Akt, the pair Sachs et al. validated by siRNA knockdown, which the current protocol discards under reject_reason no_atomic_perturbation_changes_validity at all three coverage levels and which the observables-only frame returns. Two facts are printed with those rows rather than discovered by a referee: all thirteen carry separation = 1, so the anchor has zero separation variance and no separation claim may be made on it; and all thirteen currently carry zero undirected edges in G0, so until lever 0 lands the anchor is a table about an analyst who already knows everything. A referee reads those rows first, then the population aggregates beneath them, network-weighted first and pair-weighted second.
what_it_would_show_if_the_framework_is_r: Lever 0 admits partially-oriented analyst graphs and the population survives it: more than 384 instances where G0 still carries an undirected edge, i.e. where the analyst does not already know the answer. On the anchor the radius separates instances a competent analyst cannot separate by inspection. PIP3->PIP2 comes back at r = 1 with safe-moves 0, and the single claim that kills it is exactly the PIP2/PIP3 orientation a biologist reading the PI3K reaction would assert the other way. Mek->Akt comes back at r = 2 with a named Z. Erk->Akt, the pair validated by siRNA, comes back with a radius instead of being thrown away for being robust. RoCA does not fire on the fragile instance, because every valid adjustment set there is biased by the same amount and the test has no power exactly in the class the radius prices, so pricing supplies something testing cannot. The harvested error process K_pub is non-trivial, asymmetric between omission and commission, concentrated near X and distinguishable from the matched null K_rand at matched |K| — which is what the locality of O* predicts and what nobody has ever measured. The certificate's DANGEROUS rate stays at or below 1.7% over 300 twin instances, and the twin and the real data agree on the identity of the first-failing retraction set. And the deliverable is a decision a posterior over graphs cannot give and the naive baseline cannot give either: not 'your graph is 62% likely to be right', not 'you asserted eight things so you can lose at most eight', but 'these two named assertions are the ones holding your analysis up, withdrawing either costs you validity rather than efficiency, and here is what to do about them'.
what_it_would_show_if_the_framework_is_w: Seven concrete outcomes, each producible by this protocol and none by the current one. (0) THE POPULATION IS AN ARTEFACT OF THE O* IMPLEMENTATION. All 831 admissible instances have g0_undirected_edges = 0 and all 518 o_g0_not_identified rejections fall at coverage 0.25 and 0.5 with none at 1.0, because optimal_adjustment_set_mpdag returns None whenever DAG extensions disagree. If the closed-form MPDAG O* does not restore a workable population, the framework is measurable only where the analyst's knowledge already orients the whole chain component, which is nobody's deployment, and that is the paper's scope rather than its result. (1) THE RADIUS IS ARITHMETIC ON |K|. The bound r_val <= min(s, |K_G0|) already holds on 337 of 463 real instances (72.8%), exceptions concentrated in insurance (55), Polzer_2012 (22) and paths (13). If on the deployment population r has no incremental value over |K_G0| and separation, H4 wins and the radius survives only through the column H4 cannot produce, the identity and severity of the first-failing claim; if that column also fails to change a decision, the radius is dropped. (2) THE INSTRUMENT IS DEGENERATE EXACTLY WHERE DEPLOYMENT LIVES. A real applied paper asserts few things, the pilot already found rho* four-valued and top-censored at |K| <= 4, and the bound caps r at |K_G0|. If realistic K_pub sizes put nearly every instance at r in {1, 2}, the radius has no dynamic range in the regime the protocol was built to serve. (3) THE KNOWLEDGE MODEL DOES NOT MATTER. If K_pub, K_llm, K_tier and the matched null K_rand give indistinguishable radius distributions on a fixed instance set at matched |K|, the framework prices a property of the graph rather than of the knowledge, and the expert-error framing goes. (4) THE ORACLE IDEALISATION WAS LOAD-BEARING. If the CPDAG estimated from the 853 real Sachs observations does not reproduce the 8-node chain component containing Mek, every Panel O radius on the anchor is about a graph the analyst never had, and every twin number inherits it. (5) THE CERTIFICATE IS DANGEROUS. A DANGEROUS rate above 1.7% over 300 twin instances means the one-sided exactness argument does not deliver the direction it claims, and the guarantee is withdrawn and reported as a diagnostic. (6) THE GEOMETRY IS BORROWED. If the never-queried stability-radius family (Sotskov/Emelichev, Goberna et al., Renegar) or AGM contraction and the minimal-correction-set literature already own the operator and the quantity under other names, the one part of the geometry claimed as unshared is not, and what remains is the measurement alone. That last one is settled by reading, not by running, which is why it is sequenced first and why its hours are booked before any radius is computed.
known_weaknesses: THE PROTOCOL CANNOT RUN AS WRITTEN UNTIL LEVER 0 LANDS, AND THAT IS A NEW DEPENDENCY THE DRAFT DID NOT HAVE. Every admissible instance today has a fully oriented G0 (g0_undirected_edges = 0, 831 of 831), because O* is computed by requiring every DAG extension to agree, and the 518 o_g0_not_identified rejections fall entirely at coverage 0.25 and 0.5. A realistic sparse K_pub therefore produces an empty population on current code. The closed-form O*(G) = pa_G(cn) \ forb is assembled from primitives already in the repo, but whether it is the OPTIMAL set on MPDAGs rather than merely a valid one is a literature claim I did not verify in the source, and if it is only valid the target Z is renamed and every r_opt sentence drops.

n = 1 ANCHOR, AND THE ANCHOR IS THE CORPUS OUTLIER TWICE OVER. Sachs is 11 nodes, 17 edges, 13 admissible instances, undirected_fraction 1.0 against a corpus median of 0.107 with 6 of 39 networks fully compelled — and, newly verified here, ALL THIRTEEN instances carry separation = 1, so the anchor has zero variance on the covariate the radius is most sensitive to. No separation claim can be made on it at all. I keep it because it is the only instance carrying real data AND an accepted graph AND author-named pairs AND approximate interventions, and because full under-determination is where background knowledge does all the work; declaring the strata and never pooling contains the tension without dissolving it.

THE HUMAN HARVEST STILL DOMINATES, AND IT IS A TASK ZE MUST INITIATE. Sixteen hours of typed reading is cut from the draft's thirty by the paired-permutation floor (six networks, not nine) and by the distance-2 locality restriction, but it remains the binding constraint and the vault's own measurement says tasks with no waiting counterparty close at 0% against 54% for tasks where someone is already waiting (n = 40). The mitigation is structural rather than motivational: the second independent transcription pass is the co-author's, which gives the loop a counterparty. If that hand-off does not happen, everything downstream — the error process, the discriminator, the EVPPI prior, the realism gap — waits.

THE LOCALITY SCOPE CUT RESTS ON EVIDENCE THIS PROTOCOL SAYS DOES NOT TRANSFER. Restricting the harvest to claims within graph distance 2 of the query is justified by the 2026-07-17 pilot's 0 of 791 silent-bias statements at distance at least 1 — measured on iSCM synthetic graphs, which is precisely the substrate this redesign refuses to generalise from. It is pre-registered as a prediction with a widening trigger, but if the trigger fires late the transcription work is done twice.

THE INTERVENTIONAL LEG IS NOT GROUND TRUTH AND I LEAN ON IT. Sachs's perturbations are pharmacological inhibitors and knockdowns that change mechanisms rather than implementing clean do(), and the ledger records that no real dataset carries both a domain-accepted graph and ground-truth interventional effects. A one-sided sign-and-ordering rule with the caveat printed is the honest handling, and it is still weaker evidence than the argument would like.

THE ANCHOR'S STRUCTURE AND ITS DATA COME FROM DIFFERENT OBJECTS. sachs.bif.gz is a discrete pgmpy network from one sdist; the 853 observations are continuous and are not in the repository at all. The edge-for-edge check against the Sachs et al. consensus network is cheap and blocking, but if it fails the anchor has to be rebuilt from the paper's own graph and the corpus row becomes a separate network.

COMPONENT RESTRICTION DOES NOT FIX EVERYTHING, and the per-component edge counts are DERIVED BOUNDS rather than measurements, because only component SIZES are recorded. Diabetes is exactly determined (26 undirected edges equal the connectivity minimum of components [3, 2x24], so 2^26 falls to 2^2, and it supplies 178 of the 280 intractable rejections); ecoli70 and arth150 are bounded (at most 2^13 and at most 2^20); insurance and child are null fixes, both holding every undirected edge in a single component. The tractability story therefore rests on the polynomial predicates, whose MPDAG-level GAC forbidden set is verified on about 2.5M cases and NOT proved, in the direction that could deflate the radius, while the exactness chain is unproved in the direction that could inflate it. Two unproved things sit under the compute budget pointing opposite ways.

phi_j IS A SAMPLED QUANTITY ON THE APPROXIMATING GEOMETRY INSIDE A DETERMINISTIC CERTIFICATE. I define it on retraction subsets rather than covering-graph shells because the covering relation has no known graphical characterisation and cannot be sampled from, and I report two reference measures rather than one. That is more honest than the draft's unspecified 'uniform sampling within the shell', and it still means the row mixes a combinatorial certificate with two Monte Carlo estimates on a metric that is explicitly not the definition.

THE DISCRIMINATOR CAN NEVER BE STRONG EVIDENCE OF SIMILARITY. Only eight applied networks are harvestable and the paired sign-flip floor is 2/2^k, so the best attainable p is 0.0078 and a non-rejection is always underpowered rather than reassuring. Every conclusion from that test is one-directional by construction.

I PRE-REGISTER SOME PRIOR-ART SEARCHES RATHER THAN RESOLVING THEM. The Taeb section 6 conflict is settled here by weight of independent full reads (three, including the vault's own 2026-09-06 reading, against one gap-fill reading), which is a judgement about evidence rather than a retrieval, and Appendix F.3 has failed retrieval three times. arXiv:2010.08611 carries two different titles across passes. The stability-radius and AGM/MCS families were never queried at all, and a bad answer there changes what the protocol is for rather than trimming it.

ABOLISHING no_atomic_perturbation_changes_validity INFLATES THE HEADLINE IN OUR OWN FAVOUR, and the draft's stated reason for it was wrong. Those 1,659 rejections are not 'instances with r >= 2': the filter tests single-element retractions of the full true-derived k_true against O(true DAG) in the subset geometry, which is why 30% of gate-passing coverage-1.0 instances still have covering-radius at least 2. It goes because it reads the truth. But returning those instances does raise the reported radius distribution, and the effect must be published as a before/after on the same instance set rather than absorbed into a new headline.

M-BIAS AND THE SELECTION NODE ARE SMALL, ARGUABLE SCOPE EXPANSIONS IN OPPOSITE DIRECTIONS. M-bias is 3 nodes and 1 directed edge with bidirected markers and admitting it admits latent confounding into a framework whose whole purchase is causal sufficiency; the single [selected] annotation found across the twelve dagitty files admits selection into the sample, which breaks it the other way. Both currently sit outside on parse flags with no written argument. The honest outcome may be two written exclusions rather than two recoveries.

THE BRIEF FIXES 'NO DEADLINE PRESSURE' AND THE VAULT RECORDS AN ICLR 2027 ABSTRACT DEADLINE OF ROUGHLY 18 SEPTEMBER ON THIS EXACT LINE, ONE WEEK OUT. I have designed to the brief. The forty-two human-hours are nonetheless real hours competing with a live submission, and the sequencing below is ordered so that the cheap blocking items land first and the protocol degrades gracefully if the harvest slips.
