total_budget: WALL-CLOCK COMPUTE: about 12 hours per full sweep, one overnight run, unchanged from the draft because the added work reuses existing draws. T1 and T2 deployment finish in minutes (Rank A is about 40 queries, Rank B on Sachs is at most 62 ordered pairs, and the existing run's slowest instance was 0.16 s with zero inexact instances). The T3 sweep runs 2 to 4 hours once all three tractability levers land; the Panel E discovery grid 4 to 8 hours; shell-failure fractions about 21 minutes (400 draws per shell at the measured 1.07 ms per GAC call, over roughly 1,000 capped instances and 3 shells, with the O*-weighted measure reusing the same draws at zero extra cost); the 300-instance twin sweep at B = 20 seeds about 20 minutes; the cached surrogate at five paraphrase prompts and the contamination probes about an hour. Without lever 0 the sweep does not produce a population rather than producing one slowly; without levers 1 and 2 arth150 needs 2^45 extensions and pathfinder already censors on three runs at a 1,200 s cap. AGENT-HOURS: about 120, higher than the draft's 100 despite the cuts, and the increase is entirely lever 0 — A1 20, A2 12, A3 22 plus roughly 800 cached model calls, A4 18, A5 26, A6 22. EVPPI's 10 hours are removed from the baseline and re-enter only on their trigger. HUMAN-HOURS: about 42, down from 60, all Ze's except the second transcription pass. Publication harvest 16 (six networks, distance-2 restricted, two passes, the second handed to the co-author); prior-art resolution 6 (Appendix F.3 and arXiv:2010.08611 4 h, a first scoped sweep of the stability-radius and AGM/MCS families 2 h, with the Taeb section 6 conflict closed by three independent full reads rather than re-read); pre-registration and the two-stage commitment 6; adjudicating discriminator, radius-transfer and audit outputs 8; Sachs acquisition, the edge-for-edge check against the consensus network, and the perturbation alignment with its caveat 6. WHAT WAS CUT, EXPLICITLY, RATHER THAN LEFT AS A NUMBER THAT WILL NOT SURVIVE CONTACT: the harvest from nine papers to six, because the paired sign-flip permutation floor is 2/2^k and k = 5 cannot reach p < 0.05 at all while k = 6 reaches 0.031, so nine was never the binding number; the harvest's scope from whole papers to the distance-2 neighbourhood of the declared query, with a widening trigger; the prior-art reading from twelve hours to six on the evidence of three independent full-text reads against one; and EVPPI from a baseline item to a triggered stage, replaced by the first-failing retraction set and its severity class, which deliver decision relevance with no loss function and are exactly what the naive baseline cannot produce. THE BINDING CONSTRAINT IS STILL HUMAN, NOW 16 HOURS OF HARVEST, and it is a task with no external counterparty, which the vault measures closing at 0% against 54% when someone is already waiting; the second transcription pass is therefore assigned to the co-author by design rather than by preference. THE SECOND CONSTRAINT IS BLOCKING RATHER THAN SLOW, and it has changed since the draft: it is no longer the prior-art readings but LEVER 0, because the measured population contains no partially-oriented analyst graph at all, so the new knowledge model has nothing to run on until the closed-form O* replaces the extension-agreement one. SEQUENCING: (1) lever 0 plus its differential, and the dagitty attrs fix — both cheap, both blocking, and the first reports a single number (how many admissible instances retain an undirected G0 edge) that decides whether the rest is worth running; (2) the two remaining tractability levers with their differentials, and the prior-art readings, which can proceed in parallel because they are human hours not machine hours; (3) delete select_knowledge and land the three-source loader with the matched null; (4) the stage-1 harvest; (5) everything else.

arms: ARM U — UNIT RECONCILIATION (runs FIRST, before any new data is generated). HELD FIXED: the 831 committed admissible instances exactly as they stand, oracle knowledge and all, because the question is about the instrument and not about the knowledge. VARIES: the denominator of the radius, across three candidate units — u1 cover-hops (what search/exact.py#radius_local_up returns, since local_up_covers keeps only MINIMAL candidates, so one knowledge retraction can cost more than one hop); u2 retractions of closure-oriented edges (the alphabet returned by retractable_edges, which is what measure.py counts as k_g0: directed in G0 and undirected in Chat, i.e. asserted PLUS Meek-compelled); u3 retractions of ASSERTED CLAIMS (r_claim: the smallest subset of K whose removal, with Meek re-closure of the remainder, makes Z = O(G0) invalid). EMITS: r_u1, r_u2, r_claim per instance and the pairwise disagreement rates with their signs. WHY IT RUNS FIRST: the audit headline P(w < r) counts wrong ASSERTIONS on the left and, as the protocol is currently written, cover-hops on the right. The committed data already say the units do not agree — analysis_summary.json /law records 110 of 463 instances where the radius EXCEEDS min(s, |K_G0|), a bound that ought to hold, with shapes up to r=14 against min=6, concentrated in insurance (55), Polzer_2012 (22) and paths (13). Pre-declared direction, in the repo's own two-stage discipline: r_claim <= r_u2 <= r_u1, so the currently reported radius OVERSTATES how many of his own claims an analyst may be wrong about, which is the same optimistic direction as the open Anti-Exchange Case B caveat. Depth cap 3 with a '>3' sentinel, derived from the committed radius distribution: 508+260+43 = 811 of 831 instances (97.6%) have radius <= 3.

ARM D — DEPLOYMENT. HELD FIXED: the information set (Chat, K, X, Y, Sigma-hat, n) and nothing else; the observables-only frame F; the instance set, drawn once and never as a function of any computed quantity; the FWL standard error from Sigma-hat alone. VARIES: knowledge source (K1/K2/K3/N1/N0), substrate tier, sample size n. EMITS per instance: r_claim (the certificate), r_u1 (the geometry object), separation s and its STATUS as a string, |K_G0|, the valid-adjustment-set class in {0,1,2,>=3,CENSORED} rather than an exact count, the RoCA verdict where the class is >=2, the sampled shell-failure fraction at the first failing shell, and the funnel row. Every row carries manifest fields arm='D', unit, and true_dag_on_path=false; a CI check fails the whole run if any Arm-D quantity is flagged true. THE ORACLE CPDAG IS NOT IN THIS ARM — the draft put it here as a 'statistical panel' level, which contradicts the arm's own CI check, because a CPDAG computed from the true DAG is a true-DAG quantity on the computation path. It moves to Arm I.

ARM I — IDEALISATION CONTROL (new; the draft's Panel O, relocated). HELD FIXED: everything in Arm D except the CPDAG, which is computed from the true DAG. VARIES: nothing of its own. Labelled true_dag_on_path=true at the CPDAG. Its two jobs are exactly K3's two jobs, one level up: it is the yardstick against which Arm D's estimated-CPDAG results are read, and it is the control that says how much of the six committed sessions is an artefact of the oracle CPDAG. No headline sentence is stated on Arm I alone, and the claim form 'robust under an estimated CPDAG' may be written only from Arm D. Naming the two oracle controls symmetrically — K3 for oracle knowledge, Arm I for the oracle CPDAG — is what makes the invariant one rule instead of two exceptions.

ARM A — POST-HOC AUDIT. HELD FIXED: the instance rows, which are exactly those Arms D and I produced; nothing enters A that did not come from them, and A never feeds back. VARIES: nothing. EMITS per instance with the truth revealed: w_c, the number of ASSERTED claims in K that are false at the true DAG — computed by comparing each assertion with the true DAG directly, which needs no yardstick at all and RESOLVES the draft's open weakness about scoring against a greedy recovering set; omission reported SEPARATELY as coverage = |K ∩ true| / |orientable edges|, never folded into w, because an omitted edge is not in K and therefore cannot be retracted, so omission moves the radius only through |K_G0| and through where G0 sits; knowledge_to_recover retained as a third, labelled comparator supplying the cascade-maximal set of the same size, so its greedy bias is measured rather than inherited. Also emits: whether Z = O(G0) is valid at the true DAG; the three-bucket sign equal / SAFE / DANGEROUS; the 5x4 taxonomy cell {ORIENTATION, ANCESTRAL, TIER, SPURIOUS, MISSING} x {BENIGN, EFFICIENCY, VALIDITY, UNIDENTIFIABLE} for every audited error, which turns the licensed narrow claim (the class of orientation errors keeping all valid adjustment sets valid is untestable by consistency checks) into a MEASURED denominator instead of an asserted scope limit; audit labels for the four filters removed from the frame; the error-placement distribution; and the calibration curve of stated confidence against measured correctness.

K1 — LLM SURROGATE. HELD FIXED: one elicitation pass, temperature 0, mandatory response cache, prompt hash and model id in the manifest, K frozen before any radius; the elicitation unit is the chain component queried for causal ORDER, never the edge pair; and — new — the presentation order of nodes inside each component query is randomised under a recorded seed. That last item is a design fix, not a report: without it the placement permutation test cannot separate 'errors cluster near X in the GRAPH' from 'errors cluster near the top of the PROMPT', and the ledger records that LLM causal error is known to correlate with mention order and textual structure. VARIES: model (two, the minimum the contamination method needs), condition (real names / scrambled names / cold recall with no data), granularity (required edge, forbidden edge, tier, ancestral — each reported separately, never pooled, and additionally reported per network). Confidence is retained as a distinct object and quarantined from the deployment arm until the audit publishes its calibration curve. The confidence-weighted soft K is retained and its radius is explicitly NOT computed, with the reason written down: the geometry of a penalty ball is undefined and our own CSCD result says soft beats hard under noisy knowledge, so the omission is a declared open problem rather than an oversight a reviewer gets to find.

K2 — PUBLICATION HARVEST. HELD FIXED: a written codebook, two independent coders, the agreement statistic reported; the dagitty attrs capture group retained instead of discarded at parse time. VARIES: the eight source publications (Shrier and Platt 2008, Schipf 2010, Sebastiani 2005, Didelez 2010, Thoemmes 2013, Kampen 2014, Polzer 2012, Acid 1996). Yield stated up front so nobody expects more: 12 of 12 files carry exactly one exposure and one outcome, 2 of 12 carry any adjusted node (3 nodes in total), 1 of 12 carries latent nodes and they are SEM error terms. Edge-level knowledge must come from prose. This arm is declared UNDERPOWERED for any two-sample test in advance rather than after: eight papers over at most 11 networks cannot support a permutation test, so K2 contributes descriptive rows and a qualitative placement comparison, and no decision rule in this protocol depends on it.

K3 — ORACLE-KNOWLEDGE CONTROL (labelled negative control). HELD FIXED: knowledge_to_recover unchanged, so the six committed sessions stay comparable. VARIES: coverage 1.0 / 0.5 / 0.25 — and, unlike the draft, computed on the INTERSECTION instance set, the triples admissible at all three levels. The marginal populations (543 / 182 / 106) are printed as a composition table and never compared, because the committed data show the survivors differ systematically (median separation 1 -> 2 -> 2, median |K_G0| 12 -> 6 -> 4), so the falling r=1 share 69.8 -> 51.1 -> 34.0% is a composition effect and quoting it as a coverage effect is the exact confound the ledger names.

N1 — MATCHED TRUE-BUT-INCOMPLETE CONTROL (the taxonomy's MISSING arm). HELD FIXED: K consistent AND true; and, new relative to the draft, MATCHED to the K1 arm it controls on two statistics — |K| and the distribution of graph distance from X to each assertion. VARIES: nothing else. The draft's N1 varied 'how incomplete', which makes it a second unmatched arm and repeats the sin the ledger records against the ER comparator; matched, it isolates correctness as the only varying factor, which is what a control is for. Note also that N1 is NOT the same object as K3 at partial coverage even though both are true and incomplete: K3's incompleteness is greedy and cascade-maximising, N1's is matched to the elicited placement, and the difference between them is the measurement that prices the greedy bias.

N0 — VACUOUS ARM. HELD FIXED: K empty, so G0 = Chat. VARIES: nothing. Its radius is identically 0 by the bound r <= |K_G0| = 0, so N0 is NOT a radius arm and any report of an 'N0 radius distribution' is confused. What it supplies is the audited-outcome base rate — with no knowledge at all, is O(Chat) valid at the truth — which is the B0 rung of the ladder and the denominator of every applicability sentence.

S6 — CONTROLLED CORRUPTION LADDER. HELD FIXED: the instance set, which must be the triples present at every level. Recomputed from the committed wrong_knowledge.jsonl for this protocol: that intersection is 250 triples over 11 networks, not the 65 the draft asserted, and on it P(w_c < r) runs 1.000 / 0.717 / 0.414 / 0.314 across flip rates 0 / 0.1 / 0.25 / 0.5, against a pooled 1.000 / 0.774 / 0.436 / 0.314 — so the draft's fixed-set series (1.000 / 0.800 / 0.754 / 0.600) does not reproduce and is withdrawn. VARIES: the intended error rate over a grid, and the error operator (uniform reversal, plus the tiered misfiling operator that flips several claims at once and has never been run on real graphs). Reports realised wrongness after the Meek filter alongside the intended rate, the rejection rate (9 draws are already recorded with their own status rather than dropped), and the BETWEEN-NETWORK dispersion, which is the finding: on the fixed set the per-network P(w_c < r) ranges 0.20 to 1.00 at flip 0.1 (sd 0.302) and 0.00 to 1.00 at flip 0.25 and 0.5 (sd 0.409, 0.404).

NC — MATCHED ERDOS-RENYI NEGATIVE CONTROL. HELD FIXED: one pipeline, the same K-selection rule, the same gate, the same coverage stratification, the same record SCHEMA (the current arms share none: ER radius records carry method='local_up_fast', real admissible records carry no method field, r_0 records carry neither), and a committed generator script, which the present comparator has never had. VARIES: expected degree across cells spanning the real band (1.60 to 9.86, median 2.92), sizes overlapped where the corpus permits, every cell reported per generator and per n with cluster dispersion. Kept despite Decision 2 because the realism audit's positive control has no other source of power — but see A1: on the non-confounded statistic this control may already fail to reject, in which case A6-1's discriminator has no demonstrated power and the protocol must say so rather than run it anyway.

axes.decision: Three real tiers plus one labelled control through one pipeline, and one change to how every substrate statistic is reported. T1: the benchmark corpus, 39 parsing networks plus M-bias recovered from its silent is_dag=False drop and carried as a declared out-of-assumption-class stratum. T2: the 12 applied dagitty files with the parser fixed to retain the attrs group. T3: real data with a domain-accepted graph — Sachs as an evaluation referent with precision and recall against it explicitly refused, plus the four bnjson networks whose coefficients are fits to real data and which supply a real Sigma-hat. NC: density-matched Erdos-Renyi, same K-rule, same gate, same coverage stratification, same schema, committed generator script. THE REPORTING CHANGE, which is the substance of this axis: every separation statistic is reported over ALL admissible instances with the undefined stratum in the denominator, never conditional on measurable. Recomputed for this protocol from the committed files: separation >= 2 is 45.4% of the 463 measurable real instances but 25.3% of all 831 (210/831); it is 14.2% of the 1,587 measurable random-generator instances but 11.8% of all 1,914; and er_sparse alone is 24.1% conditional but 17.6% unconditional. The gap that the substrate argument rests on falls from 31.2 points to 13.5 points against random-generators-pooled, and from 21.3 points to 7.7 points against the sparse Erdos-Renyi cell, purely by putting the two differently-selected measurable subsets in a common denominator. SECOND REPORTING CHANGE: the unit of evidence is the NETWORK, not the instance. Measured here from instances.jsonl, the per-network intraclass correlation of the separation >= 2 indicator is 0.544 over 25 clusters with mean cluster size 33.2, giving a design effect of 17.1 and an effective sample size of 48.7 — so the 831 instances are worth about 49 independent observations, and the 95% interval on 25.3% is plus or minus 12.2 points rather than plus or minus 3.0. All intervals are cluster-bootstrapped by network (BCa, 2,000 resamples) and the design effect is printed beside every rate. bnRep is therefore not decoration: since n_eff is approximately k/ICC, a plus-or-minus-5-point interval needs about 209 instance-yielding networks and a plus-or-minus-10-point interval about 52, against the 25 we have. bnRep enters as a STRUCTURE-ONLY tier (no elicitation) to raise the cluster count for the substrate claim. The declared statistic a substrate must match is the joint of mean degree, undirected fraction, chain-component size distribution, and the distribution of separation from X to the nearest member of O(G0) inside the component — with separation reported unconditionally.
axes.justification: The ledger's A1 headline is that the founding non-exchangeability measurement does not survive its own files, and the two specific defects it names are a refuted infinite-radius figure and an unmatched comparator. Both are handled by the NC arm. The defect it names but does not price is the third one, and it is larger than either: the undefined-separation rate differs 2.6-fold between the arms, 44.3% real against 17.1% random, so every published version of this comparison conditions on a differently-selected subset in each arm. Recomputing on a common denominator is not a refinement, it more than halves the effect. The clustering correction is forced by the ledger's own convention that seed variance is reported rather than point estimates, together with the measured shape of the corpus: 25 networks yield 831 instances but the counts are [3, 3, 4, 6, 6, 7, 8, 10, 10, 11, 11, 11, 11, 13, 13, 20, 23, 32, 35, 42, 48, 66, 89, 160, 189], so two networks supply 42% of all instances and a binomial interval on 831 is a fiction. Density dominates size 6.7x against 1.75x, so the comparator must be matched on expected degree, which the real corpus supplies. M-bias is recovered because it is the textbook structure in which a consistent-looking adjustment choice opens a collider path, which is the exact failure being priced. Provenance is one pgmpy sdist, so this is a corpus claim, and bnRep's 200-plus networks from 150-plus publications with acquisition mode recorded per network is the only route to a population claim — and, by the n_eff arithmetic above, the only route to an interval narrow enough to state one.
axes.falsifiable_check: Pre-registered, and the first rule is already close to firing on data in the tree, which is the point of writing it this way. RULE 1: the substrate claim is stated only if the cluster-bootstrap 95% interval on the difference (real minus matched Erdos-Renyi) in separation >= 2, computed over ALL admissible instances in both arms, excludes zero. Current evidence: the unconditional real rate is 25.3% with a cluster interval of plus or minus 12.2 points, against 17.6% for the sparse Erdos-Renyi cell — a 7.7-point gap inside a 24-point-wide interval. If the matched control reproduces that, the substrate claim is DROPPED and the report states that the earlier gap was the joint product of a density-tuning defect and a conditional denominator, not a property of real structure. The threshold is an interval-overlap rule rather than a fixed point difference because a fixed threshold on a rate whose interval is plus or minus 12 points is not a decision rule. RULE 2, the embargo: no claim about real-versus-synthetic structure is written until the number of instance-yielding networks reaches 52, the count at which a 10-point gap becomes resolvable (n_eff = 96 at the measured ICC of 0.544). If bnRep filtering does not reach 52, the axis reports the descriptive real side and no comparison. RULE 3: if bnRep's median undirected fraction falls outside the cluster-bootstrap interval implied by the 39 networks, 'real networks are mostly compelled' is withdrawn as a population claim and restated as a statement about this sdist. RULE 4: once M-bias is recovered, if the pipeline returns a radius on it without a written argument about causal sufficiency, that is the defect the silent drop concealed and it is reported as one.
axes.cost: Measured: CPDAG computation over the whole corpus is 60.95 s. The NC sweep at four density cells by eight sizes by 30 seeds is about 960 draws at the measured 8.6 ms mean radius cost, minutes of wall. Cluster bootstrap at 2,000 resamples over 25 to 52 clusters is seconds. Agent: 6 h for the committed NC generator and its acquisition manifest, 3 h to fetch and index bnRep as structure-only, 1 h for the parser fix, 2 h for the cluster-bootstrap and design-effect reporting layer. Human: 2 h to write the M-bias causal-sufficiency argument and the substrate-matching paragraph. CUT, and stated as a cut: no elicitation is run on bnRep. That confines bnRep's benefit to the substrate claim and leaves the audit headline at 25 networks, which is recorded as a known weakness rather than hidden.

axes.decision: Delete 'screen all n(n-1) ordered pairs and reject post hoc'. Replace it with a declared observables-only frame F applied per (network, K): compute G0 = Meek(Chat, K); draw X from nodes in or adjacent to an undirected component of Chat of size at least 2; draw Y from possible_descendants(G0, X) minus X; keep the pair if O(G0) is identified in G0; then take a deterministic seeded stride over the sorted frame to the per-network budget. Never adaptive. Every filter that reads the true DAG leaves the frame and becomes an audit label in Arm A: no_causal_path, no_valid_adjustment_set, empty_set_trivially_valid, no_atomic_perturbation_changes_validity. THE FRAME SIZE IS A LOWER BOUND, NOT A NUMBER: 115,974 minus 66,330 minus 42,618 minus 518 minus 280 leaves 6,228, but the observable test Y in possde(X, G0) is strictly WEAKER than the true-descendant test it replaces — possible descendants in a consistent G0 are a superset of true descendants — so the frame keeps more than 6,228 and the true size must be measured before the budget is set. The stride rule is committed before the size is measured. Per pair, record the valid-adjustment-set CLASS in {0, 1, 2, >=3, CENSORED} via a bounded search rather than an exact count, because the only decision it feeds is whether the incumbent test has power (which needs >= 2), and an exact count is an enumeration this protocol will not pay for. Per-network _meta row records total_ordered_pairs, frame_size, sampled_pairs, the REALISED rate as sampled over frame, and the seed; the current sampling_rate field records the target fraction and disagrees with the stride realisation by up to 23%. Every aggregate is reported twice, pair-weighted and network-weighted, with zero-yield networks in the denominator, and every interval is cluster-bootstrapped by network. Settle one vestigial cap before the frame is fixed: measure.py:235 rejects 280 pairs as o_g0_extensions_intractable when G0 has more than 12 undirected edges, but everything downstream of that line on this path is the enumeration-free MPDAG criterion (optimal_adjustment_set_mpdag, is_gac_valid_mpdag), so the cap may be guarding a cost no longer paid; a one-line differential on exactly those 280 pairs settles it, and if it does not guard a real cost the instances return and the sentinel is retired.
axes.justification: Ledger A2 measures that five admissibility filters read the true DAG, and the invariant forbids them on the deployment path. It also measures that the budget sits on the wrong side of the filter: 115,974 pairs screened for 831 admissible on 25 of 39 networks, with treatment-not-in-or-adjacent-to-component alone burning 66,330, and pathfinder spending its entire 1,200 s cap on screening and producing no radius at all (three censored runs are recorded with wall_until_timeout_s = 1200.0). Because O* = pa(cn(X,Y)) minus forb(X,Y) is a local functional of the graph around the query, the frame determines the answer rather than merely sampling it, so an undeclared frame is not a neutral choice. The lower-bound framing matters because the draft quoted 6,228 as a figure and then built a budget and a weakness statement on it; the arithmetic that produces 6,228 assumes the observable causal-path test removes exactly the 42,618 pairs the true-DAG test removed, which it cannot. The valid-set class rather than count is a direct application of the ledger's rule that a measurement limit is recorded separately from a structural rejection, applied before the measurement is taken rather than after. Dual weighting is mandatory because the two weights differ materially here, 45.4 against 35.6 on separation and 61.1 against 71.3 on the r=1 share.
axes.falsifiable_check: RULE 1, and its DIRECTION is pre-declared, which the draft's version was not. The frame must not select for pairs where the radius is trivially defined. The frame returns the 3,738 instances previously deleted as empty_set_trivially_valid, and those are precisely instances where O(G0) is empty or near-empty, so separation from X to the nearest member of O(G0) is UNDEFINED for them. The prediction is therefore that F's undefined-separation rate RISES, to roughly (368 + 3,738) / 6,228 = 65.9%, and the alarm is a rate that FALLS below the committed 44.3%. Decision rule: if F's undefined-separation rate is below 44.3%, the frame is selecting on the very covariate the headline is about; the before-and-after distributions are printed and every aggregate is re-weighted to the frame's own strata rather than quoted pooled. The draft's threshold (35%, derived from a 9.8-point spread on a different statistic) is withdrawn as ungrounded. RULE 2: the audit labels are reported as rates. If more than a fifth of Arm-D instances turn out in Arm A to have been trivially adjustable by the empty set, the deployment arm is issuing certificates on instances that never needed one, and the applicability figure is restated net of them. RULE 3: the measured frame size must be at least 6,228; a smaller frame means the observable causal-path test is stricter than the true-DAG one, which would be a bug in the replacement and halts the run.
axes.cost: The expensive gate leaves with the invariant, so the frame is cheap: one Meek closure plus one polynomial validity call, measured at a worst case of 1.07 ms at n=20, over a frame of at least 6,228 per knowledge configuration, so minutes rather than hours. Agent: 4 h for the frame and its before-and-after population report, 2 h for the bounded valid-set classifier, 1 h for the realised-count field, 1 h for the vestigial-cap differential. Human: 1 h to sign off the frame before it runs, since it is the choice that determines the answer.

axes.decision: select_knowledge is removed from the deployment path outright. K comes from K1 (LLM surrogate), K2 (publication harvest), N1 (matched true-incomplete), N0 (empty); K3 survives only as a labelled negative control and as the cascade comparator. The elicitation unit is the chain component queried for causal order, covering all 767 orientable edges over 276 components in one pass per component, with node presentation order randomised under a recorded seed. All fourteen items the ledger's A3 list requires are emitted, and the four the draft left out are named here explicitly. (1) Admissibility: every K is passed through Meek Algorithm 1 and the reported error is the fraction of assertions that are CONSISTENT AND FALSE, never 'noise'. (2) Coverage per granularity, four granularities never pooled. (3) Placement as a distance distribution from X, not a scalar. (4) Error rate on one scale — and, ADDED, on the SAME scale as the neighbouring published arms, so the surrogate's rate can be read against CSCD's 0.3 reversal and b-LOAD's rho and mu rather than merely alongside them. (5) Error asymmetry — and, CORRECTED, commission and omission are not two components of one w: w_c counts asserted claims false at the truth and is the only quantity the retraction operator can repair, while omission is reported separately as coverage over orientable edges, because an omitted edge is not in K and cannot be retracted. (6) Error correlation via a permutation test against a same-count uniform null, plus the tiered misfiling operator. (7) Dependence on graph position — and, ADDED, on EDGE TYPE, data-compelled against orientable, which the draft omitted and which is the second half of the ledger's item. (8) Consistency survivorship: pre-filter, post-filter, rejection rate. (9) Elicitation form declared, cycles-before-repair emitted. (10) Assertion-type stratification, split by granularity AND — ADDED explicitly — per network. (11) Prompt as part of the error model: versioned and hashed, and the graph-space clustering test is run BESIDE a text-space one against mention order, which the randomised presentation order makes identifiable. (12) Provenance and mandatory cache. (13) Confidence retained not thresholded, quarantined until the calibration curve exists, with the soft-K object retained and its radius declared out of scope for a written reason. (14) The MISSING arm, implemented as N1 and matched. Plus the taxonomy's classify() over the 5x4 cells, which is what makes the licensed narrow claim a measured denominator.
axes.justification: This is the largest defect against the invariant and the ledger states it as measured: select_knowledge calls knowledge_to_recover(dag, cpdag), so at coverage 1.0 — 543 of 831 instances, 65% — G0 IS the true DAG exactly, with zero undirected edges. knowledge_to_recover is additionally greedy and cascade-maximising, which biases |K_G0| downward and makes it the wrong generator and the right yardstick. The commission/omission correction is not a reporting preference, it is what makes the audit headline well-posed: the guarantee says that retracting fewer than r claims cannot invalidate Z, and retraction acts only on things that were asserted, so a headline P(w < r) that puts omissions into w is measuring a repair the operator cannot make. Once w is commission-only, the chain is clean: if w_c < r_claim then Meek(Chat, K minus the false claims) is reachable inside the certified region and is a supergraph of the truth, so validity there transfers to the true DAG by the b-adjustment criterion's soundness — and that transfer is exactly what Panel E's estimated Chat puts at risk, which is why the two arms are separate. Causal-order elicitation is forced by measurement: pairwise queries to an imperfect expert produced over 3,000 cycles on Child and over 5,000 on Neuropathic against zero under triplet, with SHD falling 177 to 28, and Child, Asia, Alarm, Insurance and Sachs are all inside this corpus. Randomised presentation order is forced by the ledger's own record that LLM causal error correlates with mention order and textual structure and persists on controlled synthetic data: without randomisation, a positive placement result is confounded with prompt position, and placement is the single most load-bearing unmeasured quantity in the whole design. The matched N1 is forced by the same discipline that condemns the ER comparator — an unmatched control is not a control.
axes.falsifiable_check: RULE 1, PLACEMENT, and it decides the axis. Run a permutation test over assertion positions with the number of errors held fixed, at alpha 0.01, reporting the effect size in hops with cluster dispersion regardless of the p-value, and run the same test in text space over prompt position. If elicited errors are no more likely to fall within distance s of X than the uniform null predicts, the retraction ball prices a perturbation the real error process does not make and the framework is refuted as an instrument for that knowledge source. If the graph-space test fires and the text-space test fires equally, the finding is about prompts and not about graphs, and it is reported that way. RULE 2, CONTAMINATION: per network, elicit with real names, with scrambled names, and run a cold-recall probe, using at least two models with per-item flagging under global false-flag control. A network whose named-minus-anonymised gap exceeds the pre-registered threshold and whose cold-recall adjacency F1 exceeds the 95th percentile of a degree-preserving random-graph null moves to a separately reported stratum and is never pooled, on the verified precedent that pooling a designed family with random ones moved a headline by 14 points (79.6% to 65.3%). RULE 3, VACUITY, and it is now a PAIRED test: on the same instances, with |K| and placement matched, if K1's radius distribution is not distinguishable from N1's on the pre-declared summary, a large radius is not evidence of robustness but evidence that correctness was not the operative variable. Paired because the marginal rates carry a plus-or-minus-13-point cluster interval at 25 networks and cannot resolve anything; the paired contrast can. RULE 4, CASCADE: the cascade-size distribution (edges compelled per assertion) is computed for K1, K2 and knowledge_to_recover on the same instances; if the elicited sources do not differ from the greedy one, the greedy-bias objection to the six committed sessions is withdrawn in writing rather than left hanging.
axes.cost: Derived from the corpus: 276 components of size >= 2 times 3 conditions times 2 models is 1,656 calls, plus 39 tier and 39 forbidden-edge queries per condition per model, 468 more, for 2,124 cached calls at temperature 0. Order 5 million input tokens, under an hour of wall with modest parallelism, low tens of euros. Agent: 14 h for the elicitation harness, cache, provenance manifest, randomised presentation order and contamination screen; 8 h for the error decomposition, placement, edge-type split and the 5x4 classify(); 3 h for the N1 matcher; 1 h for the parser fix that makes K2 possible at all. Human: 16 h for the eight-paper double coding plus 3 h for the codebook. That coding is the binding human cost of the protocol and the only step an agent cannot absorb.

axes.decision: Centre at G0 = Meek(Chat, K) and never at the truth, which the code already satisfies. THE UNIT IS THE DECISION OF THIS AXIS, AND IT IS TWO UNITS, NOT ONE. r_claim, the analyst-facing certificate, is denominated in ASSERTED CLAIMS: the smallest subset of K whose removal, with Meek re-closure, invalidates Z = O(G0). r_d, the geometry object, is the cover-hop distance in the fixed estimated-skeleton sub-poset, declared in conventions.py before any radius is measured and stated as a conjecture carrying its measured support. They are not approximations of each other and neither is 'the definition': one is what a practitioner can act on ('you may be wrong about up to r_claim minus 1 of your claims'), the other is what compares with the poset literature, and the protocol reports both with their disagreement rate and its sign. Never SHD. No rank arithmetic on the poset. Operator: retraction, derived rather than assumed, since failure is upward-closed and a flip therefore costs exactly two atomic moves. Two moves are added because they are named granularities with no defined move: forbidden-edge retraction and tier block-retraction, tier-unit radii reported in their own stratum. Ancestral constraints are elicited and NOT perturbed, declared as an open gap rather than faked. Reference measure: the shell failure fraction, computed on the covers the search already generates, SAMPLED at 384 covers per shell (the worst-case n for a plus-or-minus-5-percentage-point 95% interval at p = 0.5, exhaustive when the shell is smaller), reported as the second number of a two-number certificate beside the measured conservativeness. Search depth capped at 3 with a '>3' sentinel, derived from the committed distribution: 811 of 831 instances, 97.6%, have radius <= 3. Five prior-art searches run before any compute is spent.
axes.justification: The ledger's A4 constraints include three hard bans — pseudo-rank and model-inclusion distances provably differ, the MPDAG poset is not graded for four or more vertices, and there is an explicit example with pseudo-distance 1 and SHD n minus 1 — and the fixed-skeleton sub-poset is the only place the gradedness obstruction can lift, because the counterexample breaks gradedness by edge addition. But the decisive fact for this protocol is one the ledger records without pricing: the committed law block reports 110 of 463 instances where the radius EXCEEDS min(s, |K_G0|), with shapes up to r=14 against min=6, concentrated in insurance (55), Polzer_2012 (22) and paths (13). A bound that ought to hold does not, in 23.8% of measurable instances, which is evidence that the quantity being compared with |K_G0| is not counted in the same unit as |K_G0|. Reading the code confirms the mechanism: local_up_covers generates candidates by un-orienting one knowledge-oriented edge and re-closing under Meek, then keeps only MINIMAL candidates, so a single retraction that lands strictly above a cover costs more than one BFS hop; and measure.py counts k_g0 as edges directed in G0 and undirected in Chat, which is asserted plus Meek-compelled, not asserted. Three candidate units therefore exist and the audit headline needs the third. The direction is derivable and it is the dangerous one: retracting one claim removes its whole cascade in one move, so r_claim <= r_edge <= r_hop, and the currently reported radius overstates the analyst's licence. That points the same optimistic way as the open Anti-Exchange Case B caveat, so the two known one-sided errors compound rather than cancel. The shell measure is licensed by our own calibration table: conservativeness 0.43 to 0.47 means roughly 44% of graphs outside the certified radius still admit Z, so a guarantee that is sound always and tight just over half the time is two numbers.
axes.falsifiable_check: RULE 1, THE UNIT RECONCILIATION, and it is the first experiment in the whole protocol because it is the cheapest place to be refuted and it can invalidate every committed number without any new data. Compute r_claim, r_edge and r_hop on the 831 committed instances. Pre-declared direction: r_claim <= r_edge <= r_hop. Decision rule: if r_claim differs from the committed radius on more than 5% of instances — the derivation is the fast_gate precedent, where a substitution the author predicted to be strictly weaker turned out strictly stricter at 16 disagreements in 46,800 cases, so anything of order percent is a different object rather than an implementation wobble — the certificate is re-denominated in claims, every number in the six committed sessions is restated in the new unit, and the law r_val <= min(s, |K_G0|) is either re-derived or withdrawn. If the disagreement is zero the units coincide, the 110 law exceptions need another explanation, and that explanation is written before any headline is quoted. RULE 2, GRADEDNESS on the fixed-skeleton sub-poset: run the covering-relation check on every enumerable chain component, which is the 68 of size at least 3 and the 19 of size at least 6. A single counterexample kills the unit and the radius is then reported in explicit atomic-move counts with the non-gradedness stated in the text. A counterexample is a result to publish, since it is the escape hatch the competing authors declare open. RULE 3, SHELL DEGENERACY: if the median sampled shell-failure fraction at the first failing shell is below 0.10, the radius is set by a handful of fragile witnesses rather than by a surface, and it is reported as a worst-case witness distance with the shell fraction promoted to the headline. The 0.10 floor is derived from the measured conservativeness: with 0.43 to 0.47 of graphs outside the radius still admitting Z, a first-failing-shell fraction an order of magnitude below the outside-radius survival rate means the boundary is a point. RULE 4, PRIOR ART, with its own stopping rule: if the stability-radius, radius-of-robust-feasibility, Renegar-distance, AGM-contraction or minimal-correction-set search returns an existing construction that is the retraction operator under another name, the differentiation paragraph is rewritten before any experiment runs and the contribution narrows to the measurement rather than the geometry.
axes.cost: The unit reconciliation is a subset search over K to depth 3: at the corpus median |K_G0| = 12 that is 1 + 12 + 66 + 220 = 299 closures with a polynomial validity call each, about 0.3 s per instance at the measured 1.07 ms, so under 5 minutes over all 831 committed instances. The shell census at 384 sampled covers per shell and at most 3 shells is about 1.2 s per instance, which is why it runs on a pre-declared 1,000-instance subsample per configuration rather than on the whole frame — a stated cut, taking it from roughly 25 h to about 4 h. The gradedness sweep over enumerable components is hours, on the precedent that a 48-element space with 110,592 verified triples ran on a laptop. Agent: 6 h for r_claim and its differential, 8 h for the shell fraction and the gradedness sweep, 3 h to write the two conventions entries and the sentinel semantics, 8 h for the five prior-art searches. Human: 6 h reading the four papers that gate the differentiation paragraph. This axis runs first.

axes.decision: Two arms, not two panels inside one arm. ARM D estimates the CPDAG at finite n with a CPDAG-emitting algorithm and a stated CI test and alpha, never a front end that emits a fully oriented DAG, because a skeleton-times-order factorisation commits to one topological order and destroys the undirected chain component the radius is defined on. ARM I is the oracle-CI idealisation, labelled true_dag_on_path=true at the CPDAG and quarantined off the deployment path exactly as K3 is; the draft placed it inside Arm D as a 'statistical panel' level, which contradicts Arm D's own CI check. Estimator: the FWL standard error from Sigma-hat alone, the same formula for population and sample, with the true DAG entering only to generate the sample by ancestral simulation. Report the interval, never the point hull. Coverage reported conditional on r, never marginally. Var-sortability and R-squared-sortability reported per cell and, for the first time, on the real corpus, since the bnjson coefficients are fits to real data and standardising is no defence against a scale-invariant statistic. ON THE 1,839.78 s WALL, precisely: the ball never calls the extension-enumerating predicate, not once, because it does not need to. O(G0) is a graphical formula on the MPDAG and validity is decided by the polynomial GAC criterion, which the module documents as O(V^2 E) with no extension enumeration and which was measured at 8.2x on the gate (20.22 s to 2.47 s over 2,240 pairs, zero disagreements) and at 1.07 ms per call at n = 20 — licensed exactly and only on Z = O(dot), where back-door and generalised-adjustment validity coincide, verified twice by different routes (8,154 criterion evaluations, non-vacuously at 3,360 both-valid and 4,794 both-invalid; and 5,304 radii recomputed identical at 100.00%). For arbitrary Z the substitution is NOT licensed, since radii differ in 29.14% of 16,926 instances, so it is used only where Z is the optimal set, which is the only Z the deployment arm reports. The r_0 leg, which is the only place the 1,839.78 s predicate lives, is CUT from the primary table and kept as a declared out-of-scope quantity with its three collapsed infinity cases given distinct sentinels and its author-induced pair filter (local knowledge set non-empty, which keeps only components the knowledge orients completely) written down rather than discovered by a reader. And the gate's atomic-perturbation loop, which re-closes Meek once per knowledge edge and would take about 95 h on pathfinder's 11,772 pairs, reads the true DAG through knowledge_to_recover, so the invariant deletes it and deleting the defect deletes the wall.
axes.justification: Every result so far is the oracle-CI idealisation and the repo's own manifest names it the largest scope limit, so the claim form 'robust under an estimated CPDAG' stays forbidden until Arm D runs. Two arms rather than two panels is what the invariant requires once it is applied consistently: a CPDAG computed from the true DAG is a true-DAG quantity on the computation path, and the draft's own machine-checkable CI field would have failed its own run. The interval rather than the point is a decision made on measurement, using three-bucket scoring because agreement hides the sign: the point hull errs dangerous 24.7% at the smallest sample and still 18.1% at the largest, while the interval errs dangerous at most 1.7% at every sample size even though its raw agreement looks much worse (7.8% against 57.0% on magic-irri at n = 200). The danger rate barely moving across a hundredfold sample increase is the argument that this is a coverage problem rather than a sample-size problem, which is why the sample grid is extended one cell below the smallest already run and why seeds buy dispersion rather than resolution.
axes.falsifiable_check: RULE 1, the DANGEROUS rate under an estimated CPDAG, and it is genuinely non-vacuous. Under Arm I with an exact search the guarantee is deterministic, so a DANGEROUS event there is a bug and halts the run. Under Arm D the ball is centred on a graph in a possibly wrong skeleton and the guarantee's premise fails, so the rate is a real measurement. Decision rule on the sibling radius's measured scale: at or below 1.7% the object is reported as a certificate; between 1.7% and 18.1% the word certificate is removed and it is reported as a diagnostic; above 18.1%, which is the best rate of the point estimator the interval was adopted to beat, the finite-sample framework is a negative result and is written up as one. The per-cell instance requirement is derived by the rule of three: to place the upper confidence bound below 1.7% on zero observed events needs 3/0.017 = 177 instances, so every Arm-D cell carries at least 177 and cells that do not are reported as unresolved rather than as passing. RULE 2: each gate substitution states its predicted direction before the differential runs and publishes the disagreement rate with its sign, on the exact precedent that the author predicted fast_gate was strictly weaker and the differential showed it strictly stricter, at 16 disagreements in 46,800 cases, all one-directional and all biasing against our own hypothesis. RULE 3: if the estimated skeleton on a network differs from the oracle skeleton by more than a pre-registered fraction of edges, Arms D and I are not comparable on that network and it is reported per network rather than pooled.
axes.cost: Arm I is measured and effectively free: 7.2 s of radius compute over 831 instances plus 60.95 s of CPDAG computation. Arm D is the only real compute, and it is CUT, explicitly. The draft's 39 networks by 3 sample sizes by 30 seeds is 3,510 discovery runs on a corpus reaching 1,041 nodes, which will not survive contact: constraint-based discovery on the largest four networks is unbounded in practice. Arm D instead runs on the 12 networks that already carry wrong_knowledge rows, so the finite-sample comparison lands on an instance set the repository has already committed, at 3 sample sizes and 10 seeds, with a 4 h wall cap per (network, n, seed) and censoring recorded as wall_until_timeout_s rather than as a dropped run. That is 360 runs instead of 3,510, and it still supplies far more than the 177 instances per cell the decision rule needs. Ten seeds is chosen for dispersion rather than for resolution — it gives a 95% t-interval half-width of about 0.72 times the seed standard deviation, and per the Sadeghi precedent (95.1 plus or minus 2.4 reproducing at 69.1 plus or minus 21.7) the standard deviation is itself the finding. Sortability is seconds. Agent: 8 h for the sweep driver and censoring discipline, 8 h to vendor and differentially test the incumbent, 4 h for the component-restriction theorem and its differential, 5 h for the schema unification and the arm / true_dag_on_path manifest fields with their CI check. Human: 2 h to sign the three-bucket thresholds before the data are seen.

axes.decision: The referent is built, not cited, and the audit is scored on a single outcome in which the radius does not appear. Per instance the audit recovers w_c, the number of ASSERTED claims false at the truth, and whether Z = O(G0) is valid at the true DAG. The certificate's operational promise is that w_c below r_claim implies Z valid at the truth, so the headline is P(w_c < r_claim), reported per knowledge source and substrate tier on a fixed instance set with cluster dispersion by network. EVERY COMPARISON IN THIS AXIS IS A WITHIN-INSTANCE PAIRED CONTRAST, and that is the design decision, not a reporting nicety: the marginal rates carry a plus-or-minus-13-point cluster interval at 25 instance-yielding networks and n_eff of about 46, so no decision rule is stated on a marginal rate, while paired differences difference the network-level variance out and are the only comparisons this corpus can resolve. On top runs the dominance ladder, five instruments on one fixed instance set scored on that one outcome: B0 certify-always (the base rate, supplied by N0, whose radius is identically 0 by r <= |K_G0|); B1 separation, the hop count from X to the nearest member of O(G0) inside the chain component, computable by a practitioner in one line; B2 the count of asserted claims surviving Meek closure, the pre-registered naive baseline unrun for six sessions; B3 the incumbent over-identification test on the powered subset where the valid-set class is at least 2, with the unpowered subset reported separately as the framework's exclusive territory and the unverified transfer to maximal PDAGs printed rather than assumed; B4 r_claim. The four designed tests run as specified: the two-sample discriminator on a pre-registered feature vector, the radius-transfer test on a fixed instance set reporting the sign, the positive control re-derived on the matched control arm, and the contamination screen. Every arm ships its generator script, because the counter-example is in the tree: no committed script produces the current comparator's data.
axes.justification: The hardest fact from the sweep is that no published study measures a domain expert's per-edge error rate, separating omission from commission, on expert-specified DAGs scored against a known-true DAG, and it survived a corpus grep, a web sweep and a gap-fill that exhausted its budget against four paywalls. So the referent is built. Scoring on P(w_c < r_claim) rather than on the radius is forced by the guarantee's own logic and by the fact that the current design makes it trivial: with oracle knowledge at full coverage w_c is identically zero, so the premise holds by construction in 65% of the corpus. Recomputed for this protocol from wrong_knowledge.jsonl: pooled over 2,737 usable rows on 12 networks, P(w_c < r) falls 1.000 / 0.774 / 0.436 / 0.314 across intended flip rates 0 / 0.1 / 0.25 / 0.5; on the 250 triples present at every flip rate it falls 1.000 / 0.717 / 0.414 / 0.314. The draft's fixed-set series (1.000 / 0.800 / 0.754 / 0.600 on 65 triples) does not reproduce and is withdrawn. The between-network dispersion is the finding rather than a caveat: per-network P(w_c < r) ranges 0.20 to 1.00 at flip 0.1 and 0.00 to 1.00 at flips 0.25 and 0.5, with standard deviations 0.302, 0.409 and 0.404 over 11 networks. B1 is chosen over B2 on measurement: recomputed here, the rank correlation between radius and separation is 0.695 on the 463 measurable instances, against 0.118 with the asserted-claim count there and 0.057 over all 831, and the radius equals min(s, |K_G0|) in exactly 337 of 463. The incumbent is a test and not nothing, so the licensed scope limit is narrow, and the 5x4 taxonomy makes it measured: the class of orientation errors that keeps all valid adjustment sets valid is the BENIGN and EFFICIENCY column, and its size is a headline denominator rather than a sentence. Epistemic restraint reads as under-delivery unless the certificate buys something, which is what sank an earlier restrained paper of ours, so the audit reports a decision-relevant quantity and not only the calibration of r.
axes.falsifiable_check: Six rules, all written before the data, all on paired contrasts. TRIVIALITY: if the paired difference in discrimination of the audited outcome between B4 and B1, cluster-bootstrapped by network, has its 95% interval inside plus or minus 0.02 AUC, the radius is dominated by a hop count and the paper reports that as its finding. The margin is tested as an equivalence rather than as a difference, and the protocol commits in advance to declaring UNDERPOWERED, not EQUIVALENT, whenever the achieved paired interval is wider than the margin — which is the honest reading of a corpus whose effective sample size is about 46. RESCUE: the framework survives triviality only if the instances where B1 and B4 disagree by two or more hops carry the audited outcome; the rule requires their outcome rate to differ from the agreement subset by more than the cluster dispersion. ANTI-MONOTONICITY: on a fixed instance set, if P(w_c < r_claim) is decreasing in the measured error rate, the instrument reads safest exactly when the analyst is most wrong, and that is the headline rather than a caveat; the committed pilot already shows the shape, 1.000 to 0.314. REDUNDANCY: on the powered subset, if the incumbent fires on more than 90% of instances where r_claim is small, the licensed claim shrinks to the silent cell and the abstract says so. ORACLE ARTEFACT, now two-headed: every headline is computed on elicited or harvested knowledge, on the K3 oracle-knowledge control, and on Arm I's oracle CPDAG, over the same instances; if any pair differs beyond the pre-registered tolerance, every number in the six committed sessions inherits the difference and the report says which survive. POSITIVE-CONTROL POWER, and this one may fire before anything runs: A6-3 requires the two-sample machinery to reject on a matched Erdos-Renyi arm, but on the non-confounded unconditional statistic the real-versus-sparse-ER gap is 7.7 points inside a plus-or-minus-12.2-point interval, so if the matched control fails to reject, the discriminator has no demonstrated power and A6-1 is reported as uninterpretable rather than as a negative result. VACUITY, reported rather than tested: the applicability funnel is the headline denominator — 969 of 7,062 nodes inside any chain component, 767 orientable edges, 25 of 39 networks producing any instance with the six fully compelled ones kept in the denominator, and the effective sample size printed beside every rate.
axes.cost: The ladder is a join over rows the arms already emit, so it is minutes of compute; the cluster bootstrap at 2,000 resamples is seconds. The expense is the incumbent's implementation, the finite-sample runs it needs, and the double-coded harvest. Agent: 10 h for the ladder, funnel, cluster-bootstrap layer and figures; 8 h for the four designed tests; 3 h for the manifest fields and the CI check that makes the invariant machine-verifiable. Human: 6 h to derive and sign the six thresholds before the data are seen, plus the 19 h of coding already counted under A3. The whole audit is cheap relative to the finite-sample arm, which is the point: the refutations cost less than the confirmation would.

known_weaknesses: The audit headline is bounded by the corpus, not by the budget, and no amount of instance-level sampling fixes it. Measured here: the per-network ICC of the separation >= 2 indicator is 0.544 over 25 clusters, giving a design effect of 17.1 and an effective sample size of 48.7 on 831 instances; since n_eff is approximately k/ICC, the binding quantity is the number of instance-yielding networks. bnRep raises that count for the SUBSTRATE claim only, because I cut elicitation on bnRep to keep the budget human-runnable. So P(w_c < r_claim) will be reported with a plus-or-minus-13-point marginal interval and every decision rule is stated on a paired contrast instead. A referee can fairly say the marginal headline is not resolvable on this corpus, and the honest answer is that it is not.

I keep the Erdos-Renyi arm, matched, although Decision 2 declined structure-matched synthetic generators. That reopens a decision Ze took and should be put to him rather than absorbed. Worse for my own lens: on the non-confounded statistic the matched control may fail to reject, in which case the positive-control test has no power and I will have spent six agent-hours on a generator that establishes nothing.

A theory lens would prove Anti-Exchange Case B, on which the exactness of every radius rests. I leave it verified-not-proved at 0 violations in 36,094 applicable triples, with the one-sided caveat travelling. Its failure direction inflates radii, which is optimistic about robustness, and I have now identified a SECOND error pointing the same way (the unit mismatch, where r_claim <= r_hop). Two known one-sided optimistic errors that compound is a worse position than one, and my protocol measures the second without proving away the first.

The unit reconciliation is the first experiment and it can invalidate the entire committed corpus of results. If r_claim differs materially from the reported radius, every table in six sessions is restated and the law r_val <= min(s, |K_G0|) is withdrawn or re-derived. I have argued the direction from reading local_up_covers and measure.py rather than from running it, so the argument is an inference from code, not a measurement, and it could be wrong — the 110 law exceptions might have a different cause entirely.

The incumbent test is stated for linear structural equation models on DAGs and its transfer to maximal PDAGs is unverified. Running it in the setting it is stated for weakens the comparison in the framework's favour, which my lens should dislike and cannot avoid without doing the transfer work first.

The surrogate is a surrogate. Even with the screen, the named-minus-anonymised gap bounds memorisation from above and domain knowledge from below without separating them, because scrambling names destroys exactly the semantics the surrogate is meant to supply. The only clean control is a graph the model cannot have seen, and this corpus has none. Randomising presentation order fixes the prompt-position confound on placement; it does nothing about contamination.

The harvested sample is thin — twelve files, one of which yields a published author's own adjustment set of two nodes. I now declare K2 underpowered in advance rather than discovering it afterwards, but that means one of the two knowledge sources Ze selected contributes description and no decision, and 19 of the 37 human hours buy that description.

The frame changes the population by at least seven and a half times, and 6,228 is a LOWER bound because the observable possible-descendant test is weaker than the true-descendant test it replaces. Nothing in the six committed sessions is directly comparable to anything the new protocol produces; every old headline must be re-run on the new frame rather than quoted, which costs a session and will look like backsliding.

A referee-facing lens would want the decision-relevant quantity to be expected value of partial perfect information, which answers what expert knowledge on a given edge is worth. I use P(w_c < r_claim) and paired discrimination instead, because they need no loss function and no prior over the expert's errors. They do not answer the acquisition question, which is the exact gap that sank our earlier restrained paper.

My thresholds are derived from pilots that carry the very defects they are meant to detect: the 48-element pilot space, and a corpus measured with the ball centred on the truth in 65% of instances. If the elicited distributions move the scale, the thresholds must be re-derived before the data are seen, and there is no principled way to do that other than a second pilot.

I recover M-bias and then declare it out of assumption class, which closes a silent drop without touching the substantive point: the framework assumes causal sufficiency, and the motivating failure mode is a collider path opened by an apparently consistent choice. A latent-variable lens would treat that as the design's central limitation rather than a stratum label.

The soft-constraint object is retained and its radius declared out of scope. Our own CSCD measurement says soft beats hard under noisy knowledge, so the geometry that would match the better-performing knowledge representation is the one this protocol does not build. Declaring it is honest; it is still a hole where a competing construction (RoaDS's adjacency-matrix penalty) already sits.
name: Three Denominators
one_sentence: The obvious protocol fixes the knowledge source and then compares rates; this one first fixes the three denominators those rates are computed in — the radius is re-denominated in the analyst's own asserted claims rather than in poset hops, every rate is reported over all admissible instances rather than over the differently-selected measurable subset, and the unit of evidence is the network rather than the instance — and each of the three, recomputed from files already in the tree, moves a committed headline: the radius exceeds a bound that ought to hold in 110 of 463 instances, the real-versus-sparse-Erdos-Renyi separation gap falls from 21.3 points to 7.7, and 831 instances turn out to be worth 49.
primary_table: Title: one instance set, five instruments, one audited outcome, three denominators declared. ROWS: one per (instrument, knowledge source) cell, restricted to the fixed instance set every source supports, so no row is computed on a population another row does not share. Instruments B0 certify-always, B1 separation, B2 asserted-claim count, B3 the incumbent over-identification test on its powered subset, B4 r_claim. Knowledge sources K1 LLM surrogate, K2 publication harvest, K3 oracle control, N1 matched true-but-incomplete, N0 vacuous. ABOVE the instrument block, a five-line funnel header per substrate tier: nodes inside any chain component against total nodes (969 of 7,062 on T1); orientable edges (767); networks producing any instance against networks parsed, with the six fully compelled ones kept in the denominator (25 of 39); deployment-admissible instances under the frame; and the number of instance-yielding networks with the effective sample size beside it (25 networks, n_eff about 46 at the measured ICC of 0.544). COLUMNS: n instances and n networks; P(instrument says safe and it was in fact safe), which for B4 is P(w_c < r_claim), the fraction of instances where the analyst's realised count of FALSE ASSERTED CLAIMS fell strictly below the certified radius, with omission reported in its own column as coverage over orientable edges and never folded in; the DANGEROUS rate, declared safe and the adjustment set was not valid at the truth; PAIRED discrimination against B1 as a difference in AUC with its cluster-bootstrap interval, because the marginal AUC cannot be resolved at 25 clusters and the paired one can; the share of instances where the instrument is undefined or unpowered, which for B1 is the undefined-separation stratum and for B3 the single-valid-set stratum; median and maximum of the instrument's value; the unit the instrument is denominated in (claims, hops, or none); and a machine-set flag recording whether the true DAG was on that quantity's computation path. Every marginal rate carries its cluster-bootstrap interval and its design effect; no decision rule in the protocol is stated on a marginal rate. WHAT A ROW MEANS: this instrument, from this knowledge source, over the instance set every other row also uses, priced against the only outcome the analyst faces — whether the adjustment set they used was valid in the world — and denominated in a unit the row names. A referee reading this table can see in one pass whether the radius earns its place over a hop count, over counting your own claims, over the existing test and over doing nothing; can see the exact fraction of a real network on which the question even arises; and can see, from the design-effect column, how much of the apparent precision is real.
total_budget: Agent-hours: about 100, ordered so that the two cheapest refutations run first. Prior-art gate 8 (runs first; it can cancel everything after it). Unit reconciliation, r_claim plus its differential against the 831 committed radii 6 (runs second; it can invalidate every committed number without new data, and costs under five minutes of compute). Vestigial-cap differential at measure.py:235 1. Frame, population report, bounded valid-set classifier, realised-count field 8. Schema unification plus the arm and true_dag_on_path manifest fields and their CI check 5. Elicitation harness, cache, provenance, randomised presentation order, contamination screen 14. Error decomposition, placement, edge-type split, 5x4 classify(), the two permutation tests 8. Matched-N1 constructor 3. Matched Erdos-Renyi generator with its committed script 6. bnRep acquisition and structure-only indexing 3. Shell fractions and the gradedness sweep 8. Incumbent vendoring and differential 8. Arm D discovery driver and censoring 8. Ladder, funnel, cluster-bootstrap layer and figures 10. Cluster-bootstrap and design-effect reporting 2. Human-hours: about 37. Eight-paper double coding 16 plus codebook 3; pre-registration and threshold derivation 6; the four gating papers 6; M-bias causal-sufficiency argument 2; two decision checkpoints and the final read 4. Wall-clock: about three weeks, dominated by the human coding, which is calendar-bound, and by the discovery sweep running in the background. WHAT WAS CUT, and why, rather than left as a number that would not survive contact: (1) Arm D drops from 39 networks by 3 sample sizes by 30 seeds to the 12 networks already carrying wrong_knowledge rows by 3 by 10, with a 4 h wall cap per run and censoring recorded rather than dropped — 3,510 discovery runs become 360, and the rule of three says 177 instances per cell suffices to place the upper bound below 1.7%, which 12 networks supply many times over. (2) The shell census runs on a pre-declared 1,000-instance subsample per configuration at 384 sampled covers per shell, not on the whole frame: about 4 h instead of about 25. (3) The r_0 leg leaves the primary table entirely and is kept only as a declared out-of-scope quantity, because it is the sole remaining home of the 1,839.78 s predicate. (4) No elicitation on bnRep, which confines its benefit to the substrate claim. (5) Ancestral constraints are elicited and not perturbed, since no move is defined for them. COMPUTE IS NOT THE CONSTRAINT ANYWHERE: the ball never calls the 1,839.78 s extension-enumerating predicate, because the deployment path decides validity with the polynomial MPDAG criterion at a measured 1.07 ms per call, licensed exactly on Z = O(dot) by 8,154 evaluations with zero disagreements and by 5,304 radii recomputed identical; the radius itself is 7.2 s over 831 instances with a worst case of 0.16 s; the whole corpus's CPDAGs take 60.95 s; and the elicitation is 2,124 cached calls at temperature zero. THE BINDING CONSTRAINT ON THE SCHEDULE IS HUMAN: the double-coded harvest of the eight source publications is the only step an agent cannot absorb. THE BINDING CONSTRAINT ON WHAT THE PROTOCOL CAN CONCLUDE IS THE NETWORK COUNT: 25 instance-yielding networks give an effective sample size of about 46, so a plus-or-minus-10-point interval needs 52 networks and a plus-or-minus-5-point interval about 209. Under the no-deadline decision those are the right constraints to be bound by, and both are stated before any number is quoted rather than discovered by a referee.
what_it_would_show_if_the_framework_is_r: The unit reconciliation returns r_claim equal to the committed radius on essentially every instance, so the certificate already spoke in the analyst's own unit and the 110 law exceptions have a separate, written explanation. On knowledge that was not read off the true DAG, P(w_c < r_claim) stays high at the measured elicitation error rate, so the premise holds where it is needed rather than only where the analyst was right by construction. In the paired contrast against B1 on the same instances, the radius beats a hop count on discrimination of the audited outcome by more than the cluster-bootstrap interval, and the excess is carried by exactly the instances where the two disagree by two or more hops, which is the rescue clause pre-registered before the data. On the stratum where separation is undefined — 368 of 831 instances today, from 15 networks — the radius is defined and discriminates, so the framework owns territory no cheaper instrument reaches. The incumbent is silent on a substantial powered subset where the radius is small, and the 5x4 taxonomy shows that subset really is the BENIGN and EFFICIENCY column, which turns the licensed narrow claim from an asserted scope limit into a measured denominator. Elicited errors concentrate within the separation distance of the treatment in graph space and NOT in prompt space, so the retraction ball prices the perturbation the real error process makes rather than an artefact of how the question was asked. The K3 oracle-knowledge control and the Arm I oracle-CPDAG control both match the elicited arms within the declared tolerance, which means the six committed sessions survive their two largest defects. And under an estimated CPDAG the DANGEROUS rate stays at or below the 1.7% the sibling radius's interval already achieves, so the object can be called a certificate in print.
what_it_would_show_if_the_framework_is_w: Each of these is either already visible in the committed data or one cheap experiment away, which is why the protocol exists. THE UNIT FAILS FIRST AND CHEAPEST: r_claim comes back materially smaller than the reported radius, so the certificate has been telling analysts they may be wrong about more of their own claims than they may, in the same optimistic direction as the open Anti-Exchange caveat, and the bound r_val <= min(s, |K_G0|) is withdrawn — the tree already shows the radius exceeding that bound in 110 of 463 measurable instances, up to r=14 against min=6, concentrated in insurance (55), Polzer_2012 (22) and paths (13). THE SUBSTRATE ARGUMENT FAILS SECOND, AND MAY ALREADY HAVE: put in a common denominator over all admissible instances, real separation >= 2 is 25.3% (210 of 831) against 17.6% for sparse Erdos-Renyi and 11.8% for random generators pooled, so the gap that motivated evaluating on real structure falls from 21.3 points to 7.7 — inside the plus-or-minus-12.2-point cluster interval that 25 networks and an ICC of 0.544 permit. THE INSTRUMENT IS A HOP COUNT: separation reproduces the radius's ordering at rank correlation 0.695 on the 463 measurable instances with exact equality to min(s, |K_G0|) in 337 of them, the paired AUC difference sits inside the 0.02 margin, and the two-or-more-hop disagreements carry no outcome signal. WHERE IT IS ALONE IT IS NEARLY CONSTANT: on the 368 undefined-separation instances the radius takes only the values 1 and 2, with 81.2% at 1, over just 15 networks. THE PREMISE FAILS WHERE IT IS NEEDED: on the 250 triples present at every corruption level, P(w_c < r) falls 1.000 / 0.717 / 0.414 / 0.314, and the per-network spread runs 0.20 to 1.00 at a 10% flip rate and 0.00 to 1.00 above it, so the instrument reads safest as the analyst gets more wrong and the between-network dispersion swamps the effect. THE INCUMBENT ALREADY COVERS IT: the over-identification test fires on more than 90% of powered instances where the radius is small. THE ERRORS ARE IN THE PROMPT, NOT THE GRAPH: elicited errors cluster by mention order and not by graph distance from X, which the randomised presentation order makes decidable. THE CONTROLS SAY THE CORPUS WAS THE RESULT: K3 and Arm I give different distributions from the elicited arms beyond tolerance, meaning six sessions of headlines were artefacts of knowledge read off the answer and of a CPDAG computed from it. Any three of those and the honest paper is a negative result whose abstract reads: we priced a quantity a hop count already predicts, on about a tenth of the edges of a typical network, in a unit the analyst does not speak, over 25 networks that support roughly 46 independent observations, in a regime where the analyst's real error exceeds the tolerance we certify.
